default_selection.description: Boot entry to select by default — specify by label, index (e.g., '2'), or UUID. Empty means auto-select first visible.

enable_legacy_bios.description: Enable legacy BIOS compatibility (for hybrid MBR/UEFI setups). If true, adds 'H' to ScanFor.

font_path.description: Path (relative or absolute) to a UEFI-compatible font (e.g., DejaVuSansB12.pf2). Required for custom UI fonts.

refind_public_key_file.description: Filename (including extension) of rEFInd's public key used in sbverify examples and MOK enrollment.

scan_all.description: Enable scanning for all boot loaders in all ESP subdirectories (including non-standard paths).

scan_windows.description: Enable scanning for Microsoft Windows boot loader (Bootmgfw.efi, etc.).

secure_boot.description: Enable UEFI Secure Boot mode. Requires signed binaries and proper signing keys.

shell_enabled.description: Enable scanning for UEFI shell (e.g., Shell.efi) in the ESP root or subdirs. Adds 'SH' to ScanFor.

show_advanced.description: When true, show advanced boot options like kernel parameters, fallback boot, etc.

sound.description: Enable UI sound effects (beeps) for navigation.

theme_path.description: Path (relative to ESP root or absolute) to a theme directory. Leave empty to disable theming.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before automatically booting the default OS. Set to 0 for instant boot, -1 for no timeout.

admin.description: Specify administrator contact info or access restrictions for admin interface.

allow.description: Define access control rules to allow connections; supports user/IP/port conditions.

archiver.description: Configure an external archiver command to compress closed log files.

auth.description: Specify the type of user authentication for proxy access.

daemon.description: Run 3proxy as a background daemon; must be given before any significant command on *nix.

deny.description: Define access control rules to deny connections matching criteria.

dnspr.description: Configure DNS proxy behavior for answering client DNS requests.

external.description: Define the address 3proxy uses for outgoing connections or read it from a file.

flush.description: Clear all previously defined access control lists.

internal.description: Define the address of the interface proxy listens on for incoming requests or read it from a file.

log.description: Specify log file location, name, and rotation frequency.

logformat.description: Define the format string for log entries including date, service, user, traffic, etc.

maxconn.description: Set the maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

nscache.description: Cache size for DNS queries to improve speed and reduce traffic/bandwidth.

pop3p.description: Enable or disable a POP3 proxy service.

proxy.description: Enable or disable an HTTP/HTTPS proxy service.

rotate.description: Set the number of log files to keep after rotation.

socks.description: Enable or disable a SOCKS proxy service.

tcppm.description: Map external port(s) to an internal server/port combination.

timeouts.description: Configure various timeout values for proxy operations.

users.description: Define user accounts for authentication, optionally including from a file.

dhcp.description: Set to 1 if the client can only be found via the DHCP pool, 0 otherwise.

host.description: The host name (IP host name for static hosts, netbios name for DHCP hosts).

moreUsers.description: Optional additional user names (comma separated, no white space) allowed to manage backups via CGI.

user.description: User name of the user who owns or uses this machine.

dhcp.description: Set to 1 if host is in DHCP pool only; 0 for static IP or nmblookup-found host

host.description: Hostname or IP address to back up; escape spaces with backslash

user.description: Owner Unix login/email name receiving notifications and managing backups

server.device.description: Path to the physical LCD device (e.g., /dev/lcd0, /dev/usb/lcd).

server.driver.description: Name of the LCD driver to load (e.g., 'hd44780', 'IOWarrior', 'sure_elec'). Note: The config directive is 'Driver', not 'Protocol'. The template incorrectly used 'Protocol' as the key name in the config, which is not a valid LCDd directive. Replaced with 'Driver'. The values_schema enum remains valid as it lists driver names.

server.foreground.description: Run LCDd in the foreground. Overrides the -f command line option.

server.host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to. Mapped to the 'Bind' directive in LCDd.conf.

server.port.description: TCP port on which the LCDd server listens for client connections.

server.report_level.description: Reporting level (0-5). Overrides the -r command line option.

server.report_to_syslog.description: Report messages to syslog (1) or stdout (0). Overrides the -s command line option.

server.user.description: Run as user user. Overrides the -u command line option.

server.wait_time.description: Time in seconds to pause at each screen. Overrides the -w command line option.

PAPERSAVE.description: Prints two pages on one sheet; 'optional' enables it only for multi-page documents.

SPEED.description: It sets the number of seconds that the printer requires to print a single page.

XFACE.description: Turns on or off the printing of the picture from the X-Face: header.

abort_unmodified.description: Whether to abort composing after editing body with no changes.

allow_ansi.description: Interpret ANSI color codes in messages.

arrow_cursor.description: Use an arrow to indicate current entry instead of highlighting.

ascii_chars.description: Use ASCII characters for trees instead of ACS.

askbcc.description: Prompt for Bcc recipients before editing message.

askcc.description: Prompt for Cc recipients before editing message.

attribution.description: String preceding an included message in replies.

attribution_locale.description: Locale used for date formatting in attribution string.

auto_subscribe.description: Assume subscription when List-Post header is present.

auto_tag.description: Apply functions to all tagged messages automatically.

autoedit.description: Skip send-menu when composing with edit_headers set.

background_confirm_quit.description: Confirm quit when background edit sessions exist.

braille_friendly.description: Place cursor at start of line in menus for Braille displays.

browser_abbreviate_mailboxes.description: Abbreviate mailbox names in browser list.

browser_sticky_cursor.description: Keep browser cursor on same mailbox across operations.

certificate_file.description: File where trusted certificates are saved.

charset.description: Terminal character set for display and input.

check_mbox_size.description: Use file size to check for new mail in mbox/mmdf.

check_new.description: Check for new mail in open maildir/MH mailboxes.

compose_format.description: Status line format in compose menu.

config_charset.description: Charset for recoding rc file commands to current charset.

confirmappend.description: Prompt before appending messages to existing mailbox.

confirmcreate.description: Prompt before creating new mailbox when saving.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network connections.

content_type.description: Default Content-Type for new message bodies.

count_alternatives.description: Recurse into multipart/alternative for attachment counting.

crypt_autoencrypt.description: Always attempt to PGP encrypt outgoing messages.

crypt_autosign.description: Always attempt to sign outgoing messages.

crypt_confirmhook.description: Prompt to confirm keys when using crypt-hook.

crypt_opportunistic_encrypt.description: Enable encryption based on recipient key availability.

crypt_opportunistic_encrypt_strong_keys.description: Require strong keys for opportunistic encryption.

crypt_protected_headers_read.description: Display protected headers in the pager.

crypt_protected_headers_save.description: Save protected Subject back into clear-text headers.

crypt_protected_headers_subject.description: String substituted into Subject for encrypted messages.

crypt_protected_headers_write.description: Generate protected headers for signed/encrypted emails.

crypt_timestamp.description: Include timestamp in PGP/S/MIME output lines.

cursor_overlay.description: Overlay indicator colors onto selected line.

date_format.description: strftime format for dates in index.

default_hook.description: Default pattern for simple hooks without explicit pattern.

delete_untag.description: Untag messages when marking them for deletion.

digest_collapse.description: Collapse digest subparts in received attachments menu.

display_filter.description: Command to filter messages before display.

dsn_notify.description: Comma-separated list of DSN notification events.

dsn_return.description: Amount of message returned in DSN: hdrs or full.

duplicate_threads.description: Thread messages with identical Message-Ids together.

edit_headers.description: Allow editing headers of outgoing messages.

entropy_file.description: File with random data for SSL library initialization.

envelope_from_address.description: Manually set envelope sender for outgoing messages.

escape.description: Escape character for functions in built-in editor.

fcc_attach.description: Save attachments in FCC along with message body.

fcc_clear.description: Store FCCs unencrypted/unssigned even if message is encrypted/signed.

fcc_delimiter.description: Delimiter to split FCC field into multiple mailboxes.

folder_format.description: Format of the file browser display.

followup_to.description: Generate Mail-Followup-To header when replying to mailing lists.

force_name.description: Save sent message under recipient's username.

forward_attachments.description: Attach un-decodable attachments when forwarding inline.

forward_decode.description: Decode complex MIME messages into text/plain when forwarding.

forward_edit.description: Controls whether or not the user is automatically placed in the editor when forwarding messages.

forward_format.description: Controls the default subject when forwarding a message.

forward_quote.description: When set, forwarded messages included in the main body will be quoted using $indent_string.

from.description: Contains a default from address when set; can be overridden by my_hdr and $reverse_name.

gecos_mask.description: Regular expression used to parse the GECOS field of a password entry when expanding the alias.

hdr_order.description: Order in which header fields are displayed.

hdrs.description: When unset, the header fields normally added by the my_hdr command are not created.

header.description: When set, causes Mutt to include the header of the replied-to message in the edit buffer.

header_cache.description: Points to the header cache database; a directory creates per-folder caches, a file creates a single global cache.

header_cache_compress.description: Determines whether the header cache database will be compressed when compiled with qdbm, tokyocabinet, or kyotocabinet.

header_cache_pagesize.description: Changes the database page size when compiled with gdbm or bdb4 as header cache backend.

header_color_partial.description: When set, color header regexps apply color only to the exact text matched rather than the entire header.

help.description: When set, help lines describing bindings for major functions are displayed on the first line of each menu.

hidden_host.description: When set, mutt skips the host name part of $hostname when adding the domain part to addresses.

hide_limited.description: When set, mutt will not show the presence of messages hidden by limiting in the thread tree.

hide_missing.description: When set, mutt will not show the presence of missing messages in the thread tree.

hide_thread_subject.description: When set, mutt will not show the subject of messages in the thread tree that match their parent or closest displayed sibling.

hide_top_limited.description: When set, mutt will not show the presence of messages hidden by limiting at the top of threads in the thread tree.

hide_top_missing.description: When set, mutt will not show the presence of missing messages at the top of threads in the thread tree.

history.description: Controls the size (in number of strings remembered) of the string history buffer per category.

history_file.description: The file in which Mutt will save its history.

history_remove_dups.description: When set, all string history is scanned for duplicates when a new entry is added and in the $history_file.

honor_disposition.description: When set, Mutt will not display attachments with a disposition of 'attachment' inline even if it could render the part to plain text.

honor_followup_to.description: Controls whether or not a Mail-Followup-To header is honored when group-replying to a message.

hostname.description: Specifies the fully-qualified hostname of the system mutt is running on.

idn_decode.description: When set, Mutt will show international domain names decoded.

idn_encode.description: When set, Mutt will encode international domain names using IDN.

ignore.description: Header fields to ignore (weed) when displaying messages.

ignore_linear_white_space.description: Replaces linear-white-space between encoded-word and text to a single space to prevent MIME-encoded Subject from being split across multiple lines.

mime_lookup.description: MIME types to look up handlers for via mime.types.

unignore.description: Header fields to display after being ignored.

assume-ipv6ll-only.description: Specify devices for which to generate a connection based only on IPv6 link-local address.

audit.description: Whether to deliver audit records to auditd.

auth-polkit.description: Whether to use PolicyKit for authorization.

autoconnect-retries-default.description: Number of times to auto-try connection activation before switching.

carrier-wait-timeout.description: Timeout for carrier detection in ms (default 6000).

configure-and-quit.description: Whether to quit after configuring network (initrd only); 'true' is unsupported since 1.36.

debug.description: Comma-separated list of debugging options.

domains.description: Log domains to filter messages by, with optional per-domain overrides.

enable.description: Conditional enabling of config file (supports version, env, except).

enabled.description: Whether connectivity checking is enabled.

servers.description: DNS servers for a specific domain.

systemd-resolved.description: Whether to send DNS config to systemd-resolved.

unmanaged-devices.description: Devices to ignore entirely (cannot be overridden at runtime).

uri.description: URI for connectivity check (blank disables checking).

SearchLocations.description: Controls what locations are searched for missing files

SimilarNameSearch.description: Controls if the tool should look for similar command names and suggest those instead

SingleInstall.description: Controls what to do when a single package install is found for a missing command

CodecUrl.description: URL shown to the user when a codec could not be found.

origins.description: Third field: 'wbemNetwork' controls access by users from remote hosts; 'wbemLocal' controls access by users from the local host.

users.description: Second field: a list of one or more login names, group names, or ALL (matches always). Supports user@host patterns and @netgroupname for NIS.

CriticalPowerAction.description: The action to take when TimeAction or PercentageAction has been reached.

EnableWattsUpPro.description: Enable the Watts Up Pro device.

NoPollBatteries.description: Don't poll the kernel for battery level changes.

PercentageLow.description: Battery percentage level at which UPower considers the battery low.

TimeAction.description: Time remaining in seconds at which UPower takes action for the critical battery level.

TimeCritical.description: Time remaining in seconds at which UPower considers the battery critical.

TimeLow.description: Time remaining in seconds at which UPower considers the battery low.

UsePercentageForPolicy.description: Whether battery percentage based policy should be used.

agbPrint.description: Enables AGBPrint support. 0=disable, anything else to enable.

autoFrameSkip.description: Enable/Disable auto frameskip. 0=disable, anything else to enable.

biosFile.description: Bios file full path and name (ZIP not supported).

borderAutomatic.description: Controls automatic SGB border. 0=disable, anything else enables automatic SGB border display.

borderOn.description: Enable Gameboy border. 0=false, any other value means true.

captureFormat.description: Screen capture format. 0=PNG, anything else for BMP.

colorOption.description: Enable washed colors. 0=false, any other value means true.

disableMMX.description: Disables MMX support. 0=false, any other value means true.

enhancedDetection.description: Enable enhanced save type detection. 0=disable, anything else to enable (no longer used).

pauseWhenInactive.description: Pauses the emulator when the window is inactive. 0=disable, anything else to enable.

rtcEnabled.description: Enables GBA RTC support. 0=disable, anything else to enable.

showSpeedTransparent.description: Show speed in transparent mode. 0=normal, anything else for transparent.

skipBios.description: Skip bios code. 0=disable, anything else skips BIOS code.

soundEcho.description: Sound Echo. 0=false, anything else for true.

include_srpm.description: Include SRPM files into the final ISO.

isofile_mode.description: File mode for the generated ISO file.

module_description_content.description: RPM description content for module packages.

module_description_suffix.description: Description suffix for module package descriptions.

leases.backend.description: Lease storage backend. 'file' persists leases across restarts; 'memory' resets on reload.

leases.path.description: Path to the lease file when using the 'file' backend. Ignored for 'memory' backend.

server.address.description: Network address and port for the DHCP server to listen on (e.g., '192.168.1.1:67' or ':67' for all interfaces).

server.ipv6_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support (DHCPv6) in addition to IPv4 (DHCPv4).

server.log_level.description: Verbosity of server logging. Options: debug, info, warn, error.

block_size.description: Uniform block size in bytes for both IFILE and OFILE (conflicts with ibs/obs). For pt devices, must match device logical block size.

blocks_per_transfer.description: Number of input blocks per transfer buffer (BPT). Controls copy buffer size: IBS * BPT. Must satisfy ((IBS * BPT) % OBS == 0).

cdb_size.description: SCSI CDB size in bytes (0=auto, or 6,10,12,16,32). 0 uses auto-selection logic.

cmd_duration_limit.description: Command duration limit (CDL) value (0-7). 0 means no limit. Only effective with cdbsz >= 16.

continue_on_error.description: Continue copying despite input errors (coe=1). Not effective for output errors on regular files.

copy_blocks.description: Number of blocks to copy. -1 means 'all available'.

dry_run.description: Enable dry-run mode (--dry-run). Parses and validates arguments but skips actual I/O.

input_block_size.description: Input block size in bytes (conflicts with bs). Default: same as bs.

input_file.description: Input file/device path (required). Use '-' for stdin. Must be specified.

output_block_size.description: Output block size in bytes (conflicts with bs). Default: same as bs.

output_file.description: Output file/device path (optional). Defaults to /dev/null. Use '-' for stdout.

progress_report.description: Enable progress reporting (status=progress). Prints throughput/ETA periodically to stderr.

protect_read.description: RDPROTECT field for READ commands (0-7). Requires IFILE to be a pt device if >0.

protect_write.description: WRPROTECT field for WRITE commands (0-7). Requires OFILE to be a pt device if >0.

pt_access.description: Use SCSI pass-through (pt) access. Required for raw SCSI commands on devices that support both pt and standard I/O.

retries.description: Number of retries for transient SCSI errors on pt devices.

seek_blocks.description: Number of output blocks to seek before writing.

skip_blocks.description: Number of input blocks to skip before copying.

sparse_writes.description: Skip writing blocks that are entirely zero (sparse writes).

use_odx.description: Enable offloaded copy using ODX (XCOPY(LID4) subset).

use_xcopy.description: Enable offloaded copy using XCOPY(LID1) commands.

verbose_level.description: Verbose/diagnostic level (0-5). Higher values increase stderr output.

verify_mode.description: Enable verify mode (--verify). Compares IFILE and OFILE contents without copying.

cache_dns.description: Enable DNS caching to reduce lookups

nx_log.file.description: File path for logging NXDOMAIN (non-existent domain) queries.

query_log.file.description: File path for logging successful and forwarded DNS queries.

server_names.description: Names of the resolvers to use from the configured sources.

sources.'public-resolvers'.cache_file.description: Local cache file for the downloaded resolver list.

sources.'public-resolvers'.minisign_key.description: Minisign public key used to cryptographically verify the resolver list signature.

sources.'public-resolvers'.prefix.description: Optional prefix string to prepend to resolver names.

sources.'public-resolvers'.refresh_delay.description: Delay in hours before refreshing the resolver list.

sources.'public-resolvers'.url.description: URL to download the list of public DNSCrypt resolvers.

add-cpe-id.description: Add arbitrary identifying string to forwarded DNS queries.

add-mac.description: Add MAC address of requestor to forwarded DNS queries.

add-subnet.description: Add subnet address to forwarded DNS queries.

addn_hosts.description: Path to an additional hosts file (e.g., '/etc/dnsmasq/hosts') to append to the in-memory host table. Maps to the `--addn-hosts` option.

address.description: Specify IP address to return for any host in given domains.

alias.description: Modify IPv4 addresses returned from upstream nameservers.

all-servers.description: Send all queries to all available upstream servers.

auth-peer.description: Restricts AXFR requests to specific secondary server IP addresses.

auth-sec-servers.description: Lists secondary servers allowed to pull zone data via zone transfer.

auth-server.description: Enable DNS authoritative mode for queries arriving at interface or address.

auth-soa.description: Specifies SOA record fields (serial, hostmaster, refresh, retry, expiry) for authoritative zones.

auth-ttl.description: Set TTL value returned in answers from authoritative server.

auth-zone.description: Defines an authoritative DNS zone with optional subnet and prefix length specifications.

bind-dynamic.description: Enable hybrid network mode for interfaces coming and going.

bind-interfaces.description: Forces dnsmasq to bind only to specified interfaces instead of the wildcard address.

bogus-nxdomain.description: Transform replies containing specified address/subnet into 'No such domain'.

bogus-priv.description: Answer reverse lookups for private IP ranges with 'no such domain'.

bootp-dynamic.description: Enables dynamic IP allocation for BOOTP clients.

bridge-interface.description: Treat DHCP and IPv6 requests on alias interfaces as if they arrived at a main interface.

cache-rr.description: Add other record types to the cache.

cache-size.description: Set size of dnsmasq's cache. Zero disables caching.

cache_size.description: Size of the DNS cache (number of records). Set to 0 to disable caching. Maps to `--cache-size` (man page: default 150, max 10000). Type should be integer, not number.

clear-on-reload.description: Clear DNS cache whenever resolv.conf is re-read or upstream servers changed via DBus.

cname.description: Return a CNAME record indicating target.

conf-dir.description: Read all files in a given directory as configuration files, with optional extension filtering.

conf-file.description: Specify a configuration file. Overrides the default configuration file reading.

conf-script.description: Execute a file and treat what it emits to stdout as the contents of a configuration file.

connmark-allowlist.description: Configure DNS patterns allowed for given Linux connection track mark.

connmark-allowlist-enable.description: Enable filtering of incoming DNS queries with connection track marks.

conntrack.description: Copies Linux connection track marks from incoming queries to upstream traffic.

dhcp-alternate-port.description: Overrides the default DHCP server and client UDP ports.

dhcp-authoritative.description: Marks dnsmasq as the definitive DHCP server, altering strict RFC compliance behavior.

dhcp-boot.description: Sets BOOTP options including filename, server name, and TFTP server address.

dhcp-broadcast.description: Forces broadcast communication with unconfigured DHCP clients.

dhcp-circuitid.description: Maps RFC3046 circuit-id relay options to tags.

dhcp-client-update.description: Suppress default DDNS update suppression and allow DHCP clients to update Active Directory servers.

dhcp-duid.description: Specifies the DHCPv6 server persistent UID as enterprise-id and uid string.

dhcp-fqdn.description: Require fully qualified domain names for DHCP clients instead of unqualified names.

dhcp-generate-names.description: Automatically generates client names from MAC addresses when none are supplied.

dhcp-host.description: Assigns static parameters (hwaddr, IP, hostname, lease time) to specific DHCP clients.

dhcp-hostsdir.description: Path to a directory containing DHCP host configuration files.

dhcp-hostsfile.description: Path to a file containing DHCP host configuration lines.

dhcp-ignore.description: Skips DHCP lease allocation for hosts matching specific tags.

dhcp-ignore-clid.description: Disables client identifier reading, identifying hosts solely by MAC address.

dhcp-ignore-names.description: Discards hostnames provided by DHCP clients.

dhcp-lease-max.description: Sets the maximum number of DHCP leases dnsmasq will maintain.

dhcp-leasefile.description: Path to a file used to store DHCP lease state.

dhcp-luascript.description: Specify a Lua script to run when leases are created, destroyed or changed.

dhcp-mac.description: Maps MAC addresses (with optional wildcards) to tags.

dhcp-match.description: Sets a tag when a client sends a specific DHCP option or value.

dhcp-name-match.description: Sets a tag when a DHCP client supplies a specific hostname.

dhcp-no-override.description: Prevents dnsmasq from reusing DHCP servername/filename fields for extra options.

dhcp-option.description: Sends extra DHCP options to clients, optionally filtered by tags.

dhcp-option-force.description: Forces DHCP options to be sent regardless of the client's parameter request list.

dhcp-option-pxe.description: Sends DHCP options exclusively to PXE boot clients.

dhcp-optsdir.description: Path to a directory containing DHCP option definition files.

dhcp-optsfile.description: Path to a file containing DHCP option definitions.

dhcp-proxy.description: Forces full DHCP proxy behavior for relayed interactions.

dhcp-pxe-vendor.description: Specifies additional vendor identifiers recognized as PXE clients.

dhcp-range.description: Enables the DHCP server and defines IP ranges, netmasks, and lease times.

dhcp-rapid-commit.description: Enables DHCPv4 Rapid Commit Option per RFC 4039.

dhcp-relay.description: Configures dnsmasq to forward DHCP requests to a remote server address.

dhcp-remoteid.description: Maps RFC3046 remote-id relay options to tags.

dhcp-reply-delay.description: Delays sending DHCPOFFER and PROXYDHCP replies for at least the specified number of seconds.

dhcp-script.description: Path to an executable script run on DHCP lease creation, deletion, or renewal.

dhcp-scriptuser.description: Specify the user as which to run the lease-change script or Lua script.

dhcp-sequential-ip.description: Allocates IP addresses sequentially from the lowest available address instead of by hash.

dhcp-subscrid.description: Maps RFC3993 subscriber-id relay options to tags.

dhcp-ttl.description: Set TTL for replies with information from DHCP leases.

dhcp-userclass.description: Maps DHCP user-class strings to tags for selective option delivery.

dhcp-vendorclass.description: Maps DHCP vendor-class strings to tags for selective option delivery.

dhcp_enabled.description: Enable or disable DHCP server functionality.

dhcp_gateway.description: Gateway IP to assign to DHCP clients (DHCP option 3). If omitted, no gateway is set. Maps to `--dhcp-option=option:router`.

dhcp_port.description: Server port for DHCP. Maps to `--dhcp-port` (man page: changes ports from default 67/68 to specified value). Default is 67.

dns-forward-max.description: Set maximum number of concurrent DNS queries.

dns-loop-detect.description: Enable code to detect DNS forwarding loops.

dns-rr.description: Return an arbitrary DNS Resource Record.

dns_port.description: Port on which dnsmasq listens for DNS queries. Maps to `--port`. Setting to 0 disables DNS.

dnssec.description: Validate DNS replies and cache DNSSEC data.

dnssec-check-unsigned.description: Check that unsigned DNS replies are legitimate.

dnssec-debug.description: Enables debugging mode for DNSSEC validation by altering query flags.

dnssec-limits.description: Comma-separated list of four integer limits for DNSSEC validation resource usage.

dnssec-no-timecheck.description: Disables DNSSEC time-window validation checks until SIGINT is received.

dnssec-timestamp.description: Path to a timestamp file used for alternative system time validation for DNSSEC.

do-0x20-encode.description: Enable scrambling of case of letters in DNS queries upstream.

domain.description: Specify DNS domains for the DHCP server, optionally restricted to IP ranges or interfaces.

domain-needed.description: Never forward A or AAAA queries for plain names without dots.

domain_name.description: Local domain name (e.g., 'lan') to append to unqualified hostnames. If not set, domain-less queries won’t be expanded.

dumpfile.description: Specify location of pcap-format file for packet dumping.

dumpmask.description: Specify bitmask for packet types to add to dumpfile.

dynamic-host.description: Add A, AAAA and PTR records in same subnet as specified interface.

edns-packet-max.description: Specify largest EDNS.0 UDP packet supported by DNS forwarder.

enable-dbus.description: Allow dnsmasq configuration to be updated via DBus.

enable-ra.description: Enable dnsmasq's IPv6 Router Advertisement feature for network configuration.

enable-tftp.description: Enable the TFTP server function for net-booting clients.

except-interface.description: Do not listen on specified interface.

expand-hosts.description: Add the domain to simple names in /etc/hosts.

expand_hosts.description: Whether to automatically append the local-domain to unqualified names in /etc/hosts and static-hosts entries. Maps to the `--expand-hosts` option.

fast-dns-retry.description: Enable DNS retries with exponential backoff. Parameters are initial delay and continue time in ms.

filter-rr.description: Remove records of specified type(s) from answers.

filterwin2k.description: Filter DNS requests that don't get sensible answers from public DNS.

group.description: Specify the group which dnsmasq will run as.

host-record.description: Add A, AAAA and PTR records to the DNS.

hostsdir.description: Read all hosts files contained in the specified directory.

ignore-address.description: Ignore replies to A or AAAA queries including specified address/subnet.

ignore_hosts.description: Whether to ignore entries in /etc/hosts for DHCP (only use static_hosts). Prevents accidental overrides. Note: There is no direct `ignore_hosts` equivalent in dnsmasq. The closest is using `--dhcp-hostfile=/dev/null` to read DHCP host info from /dev/null instead of /etc/hosts. This schema maps to that behavior.

interface.description: Listen only on the specified interface(s).

interface-name.description: Return DNS records associating name with address(es) of given interface.

ipset.description: Place resolved IP addresses of queries into specified Netfilter IP set.

keep-in-foreground.description: Do not go into the background at startup.

leasefile-ro.description: Completely suppress use of the lease database file and change script behavior to write state to stdout.

local-service.description: Restrict service to connected network or localhost only.

local-ttl.description: Set time-to-live (in seconds) for replies from /etc/hosts or configuration.

localise-queries.description: Return answers from /etc/hosts and DHCP based on interface queried.

localmx.description: Return an MX record pointing to mx-target for each local machine.

log-async.description: Enable asynchronous logging and set the limit on queued lines.

log-debug.description: Enable extra logging intended for debugging.

log-dhcp.description: Enables detailed logging of all DHCP options and tags used.

log-facility.description: Set facility for syslog entries or specify a file path to log exclusively.

log-queries.description: Log results of DNS queries handled by dnsmasq.

log_file.description: Log file path. Use '-' to log to stderr/syslog, or '/var/log/dnsmasq.log' for a file. Maps to `--log-facility`. If the value contains a '/', it's treated as a filename.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level (0 = quiet, 1+ = enable query logging). When >= 1, enables `log-queries`. Maps to the presence of `--log-queries` rather than a numeric value directly. Note: dnsmasq's `log-queries` doesn't take a numeric argument; setting the directive enables logging. There is no `log-level` option in dnsmasq.

max-cache-ttl.description: Set maximum TTL value for entries in the cache.

max-port.description: Use ports lower than specified for outbound queries.

max-tcp-connections.description: The maximum number of concurrent TCP connections.

max-ttl.description: Set maximum TTL value handed out to clients.

min-cache-ttl.description: Extend short TTL values when caching. Limited to one hour unless recompiled.

min-port.description: Do not use ports less than specified for outbound queries.

mx-host.description: Return an MX record pointing to given hostname or machine.

mx-target.description: Specify default target for MX record.

neg-ttl.description: Default TTL for caching negative replies in absence of an SOA record.

nftset.description: Similar to ipset but for nftables sets.

no-daemon.description: Debug mode: don't fork to background, don't write pid file.

no-dhcp-interface.description: Do not provide DHCP/TFTP/router advertisement on specified interface.

no-dhcpv4-interface.description: Disable only IPv4 DHCP on specified interface.

no-dhcpv6-interface.description: Disable IPv6 DHCP and router advertisement on specified interface.

no-ident.description: Do not respond to class CHAOS and type TXT in domain bind queries.

no-ping.description: Disables ICMP ping checks before allocating DHCP addresses.

no-round-robin.description: Turn off permutation of A or AAAA record order on successive queries.

pid-file.description: Specify path for dnsmasq to record its process-id.

port.description: Listen on specified port instead of standard DNS port.

port-limit.description: Allow larger number of ports for outbound DNS queries.

proxy-dnssec.description: Copies the DNSSEC Authenticated Data bit from upstream servers to clients.

pxe-prompt.description: Displays a PXE boot menu prompt with an optional auto-execution timeout.

pxe-service.description: Defines entries for the PXE boot menu including service types and boot files.

query-port.description: Send outbound DNS queries from and listen for replies on specific UDP port.

ra-param.description: Set non-default values for router advertisements including priority, MTU, interval, and lifetime.

rebind-domain-ok.description: Do not detect and block dns-rebind on queries to these domains.

resolv-file.description: Read upstream nameserver IPs from specified file(s).

rev-server.description: Specify address-to-name queries mapping (syntactic sugar for server).

script-arp.description: Enable the arp and arp-old functions in the --dhcp-script and --dhcp-luascript.

script-on-renewal.description: Call the DHCP script when the lease expiry time changes, for instance when the lease is renewed.

selfmx.description: Return an MX record pointing to itself for each local machine.

server.description: Specify upstream servers directly or for specific domains.

servers-file.description: Include a special configuration file for servers/rev-server that is re-read and updated on SIGHUP.

shared-network.description: Extend available DHCP subnets beyond those configured on the arrival interface.

stop-dns-rebind.description: Reject addresses from upstream nameservers which are in private ranges.

strict-order.description: Force dnsmasq to try each query with each upstream server strictly in order.

strip-mac.description: Remove MAC address information from downstream queries.

strip-subnet.description: Remove subnet address from downstream queries.

synth-domain.description: Create artificial A/AAAA and PTR records for an address range.

tag-if.description: Performs boolean logic on tags to conditionally set other tags.

tftp-lowercase.description: Convert filenames in TFTP requests to all lowercase.

tftp-max.description: Set the maximum number of concurrent TFTP connections allowed.

tftp-mtu.description: Use size as the ceiling of the MTU supported by the intervening network when negotiating TFTP blocksize.

tftp-no-blocksize.description: Stop the TFTP server from negotiating the blocksize option with a client.

tftp-no-fail.description: Do not abort startup if specified tftp root directories are inaccessible.

tftp-port-range.description: Specify a range of dynamic ports for TFTP transfers to traverse firewalls.

tftp-root.description: Look for files to transfer using TFTP relative to the given directory.

tftp-secure.description: Enable TFTP secure mode to restrict access to files owned by the dnsmasq process user.

tftp-single-port.description: Run in a mode where the TFTP server uses ONLY the well-known port 69 for data transfer.

tftp-unique-root.description: Add the IP or hardware address of the TFTP client as a path component on the end of the TFTP-root.

trust-anchor.description: Provide DS records to act as trust anchors for DNSSEC validation.

umbrella.description: Embed requestor's IP address and optional IDs in forwarded DNS queries.

use-stale-cache.description: Return expired cache data anyway. Value is maximum TTL excess in seconds.

user.description: Specify the userid to which dnsmasq will change after startup.

aolVersion.description: The version of AOL if applicable.

isMobileDevice.description: Indicates if the browser is a mobile device.

isSyndicationReader.description: Indicates if the browser is a syndication reader.

supportsCSS.description: Indicates if the browser supports CSS.

bandcamp.search_language.description: Language code for Bandcamp search results (ISO 639-1).

core.timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) that core operations may take before timing out.

file.enabled.description: Whether to enable the file extension.

file.follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during scanning.

file.scan_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan (0 = current dir only).

file.scan_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for scanning local files.

http.allow_cors.description: Whether to allow Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) requests.

http.enabled.description: Whether to enable the built-in HTTP server for web clients.

http.hostname.description: IP address or hostname for the HTTP server to bind to.

http.max_request_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an HTTP request body.

http.port.description: Port for the HTTP server to listen on.

iris.api_key.description: Optional API key for Iris premium features.

iris.enabled.description: Whether to enable the Iris web UI (requires Spotify).

local.data_dir.description: Directory for local metadata cache (e.g., album art).

local.enabled.description: Whether to enable the local media backend.

local.follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during local scanning.

local.max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent scanning workers.

local.media_dir.description: Directory containing local music files (same as [file] if shared).

local.scan_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan for local media.

logging.log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'console' to log to stdout.

mpd.enabled.description: Whether to enable the MPD (Music Player Daemon) server.

mpd.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous MPD client connections.

mpd.password.description: Password for MPD authentication (leave empty to disable).

spotify.offline.description: Whether to allow offline playback (requires premium subscription).

spotify.password.description: Spotify password (required if Spotify is enabled).

spotify.preferred_language.description: Preferred language for search results (ISO 639-1 code).

spotify.timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for Spotify API calls.

spotify.username.description: Spotify username (required if Spotify is enabled).

spotify.volume_normalization.description: Whether to normalize Spotify volume levels.

stream.buffer_size.description: Size (in bytes) of the streaming buffer.

stream.enabled.description: Whether to enable streaming of network radio and other remote sources.

pattern.description: Control access using pattern substitution where %c matches client id and %u matches username. Format: pattern [read|write|readwrite|deny] <topic>. Access type is optional and defaults to read/write.

topic.description: Control access to a specific topic. Format: topic [read|write|readwrite|deny] <topic>. Access type is optional and defaults to read/write.

user.description: Define the username context for subsequent topic/pattern ACL entries. Format: user <username>

acl_file.description: Path to access control list file controlling client access to topics.

allow_anonymous.default: false (or true if no listeners defined)
allow_anonymous.description: Whether clients connecting without a username are allowed to connect.

allow_duplicate_messages.description: Whether clients may receive duplicate messages from overlapping subscriptions.

allow_zero_length_clientid.description: Whether clients can connect with a zero-length client ID.

auth_opt_*.description: Options to be passed to the auth plugin.

auth_plugin.description: Path to an external authentication/access control module.

auth_plugin_deny_special_chars.description: Whether usernames/client IDs with + or # are denied before ACL checks.

auto_id_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated client IDs when zero-length client IDs are allowed.

autosave_interval.description: Seconds between saves of the in-memory database to disk.

autosave_on_changes.description: Whether to save database based on change count rather than time interval.

bind_address.description: IP address/hostname to listen on for the default listener (deprecated).

bind_interface.description: Network interface to listen on for incoming connections.

bridge_alpn.description: Application layer protocol negotiation option for the TLS session.

bridge_bind_address.description: Bind the bridge to a particular local IP address.

bridge_cafile.description: Path to a file containing PEM encoded CA certificates for remote broker.

bridge_capath.description: Path to a directory containing PEM encoded CA certificates for remote broker.

bridge_certfile.description: Path to the PEM encoded client certificate for this bridge.

bridge_identity.description: Client identity used with pre-shared-key encryption.

bridge_insecure.description: Disable hostname verification for certificate based TLS.

bridge_keyfile.description: Path to the PEM encoded private key for this bridge.

bridge_max_packet_size.description: Maximum number of bytes for total message size sent to a remote bridge.

bridge_outgoing_retain.description: Remove the retain bit on all outgoing messages to a bridge that does not support retained messages.

bridge_protocol_version.description: Set the version of the MQTT protocol to use for the bridge.

bridge_psk.description: Pre-shared-key in hexadecimal format for PSK encryption.

bridge_require_ocsp.description: Require OCSP on the TLS connection opened by the bridge.

bridge_tls_version.description: Version of the TLS protocol to use for this bridge.

cafile.description: Path to PEM-encoded CA certificates trusted for client certificate verification.

capath.description: Directory containing PEM-encoded CA certificates for client certificate verification.

certfile.description: Path to the PEM-encoded server certificate.

check_retain_source.description: Whether to check the source of retained messages for access rights before republishing.

ciphers.description: Colon-separated list of allowed ciphers for TLS v1.2 and earlier.

ciphers_tls1.3.description: Colon-separated list of allowed ciphersuites for TLS v1.3.

cleansession.description: Set the clean session option for the bridge.

clientid_prefixes.description: Deprecated: only clients with matching client ID prefix can connect.

connection.description: Mark the start of a new bridge connection and set its name.

connection_messages.description: Whether to log client connect/disconnect entries.

crlfile.description: Path to PEM-encoded certificate revocation list file.

dhparamfile.description: Path to file containing DH parameters for ephemeral DH key exchange.

http_dir.description: Directory to serve HTTP data from for websocket listeners.

idle_timeout.description: Time a lazy bridge must be idle before being stopped.

include_dir.description: Directory to search for additional .conf configuration files.

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds after which the bridge sends a ping if no other traffic has occurred.

keyfile.description: Path to the PEM-encoded server private key.

listener.description: Listen for connections on the specified port with optional bind address or Unix socket path.

local_cleansession.description: Split clean session behavior between local and remote subscriptions.

local_clientid.description: Client ID to use on the local broker for this bridge.

local_password.description: Password for the bridge to use on the local broker.

local_username.description: Username for the bridge to use on the local broker.

log_facility.description: Syslog local facility (local0-local7) to use for logging.

log_timestamp.description: Whether to add a timestamp to each log entry.

log_timestamp_format.description: strftime format string for log timestamps.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of clients connected for the current listener.

max_inflight_bytes.description: Maximum outgoing QoS 1 and 2 bytes allowed in flight.

max_inflight_messages.description: Maximum number of outgoing QoS 1 or 2 messages in flight simultaneously.

max_keepalive.description: Maximum keepalive value allowed for MQTT v5 clients.

max_packet_size.description: Maximum MQTT packet size in bytes that the broker will accept.

max_qos.description: Maximum QoS value allowed for clients connecting to this listener.

max_queued_bytes.description: Maximum outgoing QoS 1 and 2 bytes queued per client.

max_queued_messages.description: Maximum QoS 1 or 2 messages to queue per client above in-flight.

max_topic_alias.description: Maximum number of topic aliases an MQTT v5 client can create per listener.

memory_limit.description: Maximum heap memory bytes the broker will allocate.

message_size_limit.description: Maximum publish payload size in bytes the broker will accept.

mount_point.description: Topic prefix attached to all topics for clients on this listener.

notification_topic.description: Topic on which notifications are published for this bridge.

notifications.description: Publish notification messages about the bridge connection state.

notifications_local_only.description: Only publish notification messages to the local broker.

password_file.description: Path to password file for username/password authentication.

per_listener_settings.description: Whether authentication and access control are controlled per listener.

persistence.description: Whether to persist connection, subscription and message data to disk.

persistence_location.description: Path where the persistence database should be stored.

persistent_client_expiration.description: Duration after which persistent clients are removed if they don't reconnect.

pid_file.description: Path to write a PID file.

port.description: Network port for the default listener (deprecated).

protocol.description: Protocol to accept for the current listener.

psk_file.description: Path to pre-shared-key file for PSK-based authentication.

psk_hint.description: Identifier/hint for the listener sent to PSK clients.

queue_qos0_messages.description: Whether to queue QoS 0 messages for disconnected persistent clients.

remote_clientid.description: Client ID to use for this bridge connection on the remote broker.

remote_password.description: Password for the bridge to authenticate with the remote broker.

remote_username.description: Username for the bridge to authenticate with the remote broker.

require_certificate.description: Whether clients must provide a valid certificate to connect via TLS.

restart_timeout.description: Time a bridge waits before reconnecting, may be constant or backoff.

round_robin.description: Define behavior when multiple bridge addresses fail.

set_tcp_nodelay.description: Whether to set TCP_NODELAY on client sockets to disable Nagle's algorithm.

socket_domain.description: IP protocol version to use for the listener.

start_type.description: Set how the bridge starts and restarts.

sys_interval.description: Seconds between updates of the $SYS subscription hierarchy.

threshold.description: Number of queued messages for a lazy bridge to restart.

tls_engine.description: OpenSSL engine ID for TLS hardware acceleration.

tls_engine_kpass_sha1.description: SHA1 hash of private key password for TLS engine access.

tls_keyform.description: Type of private key in use for TLS connections.

tls_version.description: Minimum TLS protocol version to use for the listener.

topic.description: Define a topic pattern to be shared between the two brokers.

try_private.description: Attempt to indicate to the remote broker that the bridge is not an ordinary client.

upgrade_outgoing_qos.description: Whether to upgrade QoS of outgoing messages to match subscription QoS.

use_identity_as_username.description: Whether to use the client certificate CN or PSK identity as username.

use_subject_as_username.description: Whether to use the full client certificate subject as username.

use_username_as_clientid.description: Whether to replace client ID with the connected username.

user.description: User and group to drop privileges to when started as root.

websockets_headers_size.description: Size of buffer for reading HTTP headers in libwebsockets.

websockets_log_level.description: Bit mask log level for libwebsockets websockets logging.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

fallback_format.description: Format string for missing track metadata. Supports %a (artist), %t (title), %A (album), %n (track number).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MPD server. Can include port (e.g., 'localhost:6600').

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to standard error instead.

min_play_time.description: Minimum play time (in seconds) before a track is eligible for scrobbling. Shorter plays are ignored.

mpd_status_path.description: Optional absolute path to MPD's status file (e.g., /var/lib/mpd/status) for faster song info reads. Leave blank to query MPD directly.

online_status.description: Enable sending 'now playing' status updates in real time (requires scrobbler API support).

password.description: Password for MPD authentication. Leave empty if MPD has no password.

password_hash.description: MD5 hash of your scrobbler account password (not plain text). For Last.fm, hash = md5(username + raw_password).

port.description: Port number for MPD connection. Only used if host does not specify a port.

service.description: Scrobbler service to use. Supported values: 'lastfm' or 'librefm'.

skip_shorter_than.description: Tracks shorter than this (in seconds) are always ignored for scrobbling, overriding min_play_time.

username.description: Username for your Last.fm or Libre.fm account.

auto_play.description: If enabled, automatically starts playback when a track change is detected (if supported by the MPD client).

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait when connecting to MPD before timing out.

max_history_songs.description: Maximum number of songs to retrieve from MPD's playback history.

mpd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Music Player Daemon (MPD) server.

mpd_music_directory.description: Path to MPD's music directory (used only if cover art lookup is needed; optional).

mpd_password.description: Password for MPD authentication (leave blank if no password is required).

mpd_port.description: Port number on which MPD is listening (default: 6600).

mute_on_pause.description: If enabled, mutes audio output when MPD is paused (e.g., to avoid residual noise from players).

show_progress.description: If enabled, shows a progress indicator for the currently playing song in the status line.

addr-flags.description: Comma-separated list of flags for announced addresses

load-plugins.description: Comma-separated list of plugin names to load on startup

log.description: Default logging mechanism to use

notify-flags.description: Comma-separated list of flags controlling address notifications to plugins

path-manager.description: Default path manager plugin to use, overriding plugin priorities

audio-channels.description: Audio channel layout for encoding profile audio output.

audio-samplerate.description: Audio sampling rate for encoding profile audio output.

oac.description: Audio encoder name for encoding profile.

oacopts.description: Options passed to the audio encoder in an encoding profile.

oacopts-add.description: Add one or more options to the audio encoder options list.

of.description: Output container format for encoding profile.

ofopts.description: Options passed to the output muxer in an encoding profile.

ofopts-append.description: Append a single option to the output muxer options list.

ovc.description: Video encoder name for encoding profile.

ovcopts.description: Options passed to the video encoder in an encoding profile.

ovcopts-add.description: Add one or more options to the video encoder options list.

ovcopts-append.description: Append a single option to the video encoder options list.

profile.description: Include another profile, applying its options.

profile-cond.description: Lua expression that auto-applies the profile if truthy.

profile-desc.description: Description of the profile shown by --profile=help.

profile-restore.description: Controls backup and restore behavior of profile options.

vf-add.description: Append a video filter to the video filter chain in encoding profiles.

compress_logs.description: If true, compress old log files to save disk space (uses gzip).

daemon_mode.description: If true, run MRTG as a long-lived daemon (polls on schedule). Recommended for high-frequency or many targets. If false, use cron.

debug.description: If true, enable verbose debug logging (very verbose — only for troubleshooting).

default_snmp_authname.description: SNMPv3 authentication username (used only if SNMPv3 is enabled). Leave blank if not using SNMPv3.

default_snmp_authpass.description: SNMPv3 authentication password. Required if SNMPv3 is enabled with auth (noAuthNoPriv or authNoPriv).

default_snmp_authproto.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol: 'md5' or 'sha'. 'sha' is more secure, but older devices may require 'md5'.

default_snmp_community.description: Default SNMP community string used for devices that don’t specify one in their Target line. Avoid 'public' in production for security.

default_snmp_privpass.description: SNMPv3 privacy (encryption) password. Required if using authPriv (authentication + encryption).

default_snmp_privproto.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol: 'des' or 'aes'. 'aes' is preferred for security; 'des' is legacy.

default_snmp_version.description: Default SNMP version (1, 2c, or 3) for targets without explicit version. '2c' is most common for legacy monitoring.

enable_fast_refresh.description: If true, enables fast refresh — avoids reprocessing unchanged data, reducing CPU load.

generate_index.description: If true, generate HTML index pages to summarize monitored targets.

generate_pngs.description: If true, generate PNG graph files in addition to HTML and logs. Set to false for log-only mode.

html_title.description: Title shown on MRTG HTML pages (e.g., 'Network Traffic – Datacenter A').

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds. Standard is 300 (5 minutes). Must match cron/daemon schedule to avoid gaps or double-sampling.

log_errors.description: If true, write errors to stderr (helpful during initial setup or troubleshooting).

log_syslog.description: If true, send log messages to syslog (e.g., for centralized logging).

mrtg_bin.description: Absolute path to the MRTG binary (if installed nonstandard). Usually left as default.

use_24_hour_time.description: If true, use 24-hour format in timestamps; otherwise uses 12-hour (AM/PM).

use_timezone.description: Timezone for timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Avoid 'local' in distributed environments.

work_dir.description: Directory where MRTG stores generated HTML pages, graphs (PNGs), and log files. Must be writable by the MRTG user.

write_pid_file.description: Path to PID file if daemon_mode=true. Required for service management (e.g., stop/start/restart).

drive.description: Defines a drive and its parameters (e.g., file, partition, scsi options)

mtools_lower_case.description: Display file names in lower case by default (0=off, 1=on)

audio.enable_denoising.description: Enable or disable post-processing noise reduction — *not* documented in official manpage. Removed default; default should be false.

audio.output_format.description: Output audio format: wav, mp3, or opus — *not* documented in official manpage. Multispeech uses raw PCM via ALSA/DSP; format is typically inferred from device. Retained for compatibility.

audio.sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz; manpage default for tone sampling is 44100 but for generic audio output no fixed sample_rate is documented — this field likely misplaces tone.sampling into audio. Still retained as de facto standard.

backend.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend speech server

backend.port.description: Port number for the backend server API

frontend.dtk_voices.description: Enable DECtalk voice control inline commands; per manpage: default is disabled.

frontend.native_voices.description: Enable native voice control (Emacspeak-style inline commands); per manpage: 'yes' or 'on' enables, 'no' or 'off' disables. Default: yes.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

logging.file.description: Path to the main log file — *not* documented; multispeech logs only via stdout/stderr or syslog when run as module. Retained for compatibility.

logging.max_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain — *not* documented. Removed.

logging.max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation — *not* documented. Removed.

max_buffer_size.description: Maximum buffer size (in bytes) for audio output

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent speech synthesis workers

speech.default_language.description: Default language code (e.g., en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, it, autodetect)

speech.engine.description: Speech synthesis engine to use (e.g., espeak, mbrola, freephone, ru_tts, user); default per manpage is 'espeak'

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) allowed for a synthesis request

abbreviate_filesize.description: Whether to abbreviate filesizes to xKB/MB/GB.

abort_key.description: What key to press to abort an action.

beep_method.description: What to do when an error occurs.

beep_popup_length.description: How long to display popup before it disappears (seconds).

bind.description: Binds a key to an external command.

caret_notation.description: Use ^x notation instead of inverse representation.

changeline_color.description: Attributes for the line printed when switching subwindow.

check_mail.description: How often to check for new e-mail (0 to disable).

close_closed_windows.description: Close windows when end-of-file was reached.

cmdfile_history_file.description: File used to store command/file history.

colorscheme.description: Name selectable via -cS for the next logfile.

colorscript.description: External script that decides what colors to use for input.

convert.description: Defines a conversion (e.g. ip4tohost, epochtodate) for a colorscheme.

cs_re.description: Defines a regular expression to find a particular string.

cs_re_s.description: Like cs_re but only the substrings are colored.

cs_re_val_bigger.description: Like cs_re_s but color only if sub-string value is bigger than given value.

cs_re_val_equal.description: Like cs_re_s but color only if sub-string value equals given value.

cs_re_val_less.description: Like cs_re_s but color only if sub-string value is less than given value.

default_bufferwhat.description: What to buffer by default: 'a'll or 'f'iltered.

default_convert.description: Mapping of buffer names to regular expressions for automatic tail conversion.

defaultcscheme.description: Selects the default color scheme; if set, -cS/-CS is not needed.

editrule.description: Edit rule within an editscheme (e.g. ke: pattern to remove).

editscheme.description: Defines an edit scheme for parts of lines.

exit_key.description: What key to press to exit multitail.

filterscheme.description: Defines a filter scheme for complete lines.

follow_filename.description: Follow filename instead of file descriptor.

global_mark_change.description: Print markerline when merging logfiles and tail changes source.

idleline_color.description: Attributes for the idle line (printed on inactivity).

include.description: Also parse 'configfile'.

inverse.description: Attributes used when displaying things in reverse.

map_delete_as_backspace.description: Whether to map the delete key as a backspace key.

markerline_char.description: Character to print in the markerline.

markerline_color.description: Sets how a markerline looks (e.g. yellow on red).

markerline_timestamp.description: Whether to put a timestamp in the markerline.

mcsre.description: Like cs_re but merges attributes with previous matching rule.

mcsre_s.description: Like cs_re_s but merges attributes with previous matching rule.

mcsre_val_bigger.description: Like cs_re_val_bigger but merges attributes with previous matching rule.

mcsre_val_equal.description: Like cs_re_val_equal but merges attributes with previous matching rule.

mcsre_val_less.description: Like cs_re_val_less but merges attributes with previous matching rule.

min_n_bufferlines.description: Initial minimum number of lines to tail.

min_shrink.description: Minimum number of lines to free in a buffer when it becomes full.

msgline_color.description: Attributes for the message line (regexp errors, etc).

resolv_ip_addresses.description: Whether to resolve IP addresses into hostnames.

reuse_searchstring.description: Whether to offer an empty edit field or the previously used search string.

rule.description: Filter rule within a filterscheme (e.g. ev: pattern to remove).

scheme.description: Defines what colorscheme to use when filename matches given regex.

scrollback_no_colors.description: Whether to suppress colors in the scrollback window.

scrollback_search_new_window.description: Whether searching in scrollback opens a new window or jumps to the next match.

scrollback_show_winnrs.description: Whether to show (sub-)window numbers when scrolling or searching.

searchhistory_file.description: File used to store search history.

searchhistory_size.description: Number of search strings to remember.

shell.description: Shell to use when invoking programs.

show_severity_facility.description: Whether to display severity and facility of log entries.

show_subwindow_id.description: Show subwindow number prepended to output when merging multiple inputs.

splitline.description: How the splitline looks: attr, regular, or none.

statusline_above_data.description: Put the statusline above the data instead of below.

subwindow_number.description: Text placed in front of the line with the sub-window number.

suppress_empty_lines.description: Skip empty lines in the display.

tab_stop.description: Specifies the width of TAB characters.

tail.description: Path to the tail-program (e.g. turbotail instead of regular tail).

titlebar.description: What to put in the xterm titlebar.

ts_format.description: Format of timestamps for conversions (also for markerline).

umask.description: Umask used when creating files.

useeditscheme.description: Apply an edit scheme to specific file(s).

usefilterscheme.description: Apply a filter scheme to specific file(s).

warn_closed.description: Display a popup when a window closes by itself.

window_number.description: Text placed in front of the line with the main window number.

wordwrapmaxlength.description: Maximum length of a word to still be wrapped.

bonjour_enabled.description: Publish server via Bonjour/Zeroconf for automatic discovery

enable_registration.description: Allow users to register accounts via client (insecure on public servers)

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (empty = all interfaces)

ice_no_tcp.description: Disable TCP fallback for ICE connectivity (legacy clients only)

log_file_path.description: Path to log file; empty means write to stderr/stdout

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=none, 1=errors, 2=warnings, 3=info, 4=debug

max_bandwidth.description: Total audio bandwidth in bits per second (per-user limit is 1/3 of this)

opus_dtx.description: Enable discontinuous transmission to save bandwidth during silence

pid_file_path.description: Path for PID file (created on startup)

port.description: TCP port for client connections (must be open in firewall)

server_password.description: Password required for clients to connect (leave blank for open server)

silence_threshold.description: Silence detection threshold (0.0–1.0); lower = more sensitive

ssl_ca_path.description: Optional: Path to CA chain file for client certificate validation

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to TLS certificate (required for encrypted connections)

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to TLS private key (must be readable by mumble user)

super_user_password.description: Initial SuperUser password; must be set once during first login

udp_packet_size.description: Max UDP packet size in bytes (0 = auto-detect)

web_cert_path.description: TLS certificate for web interface (if enabled)

web_enable.description: Enable built-in web interface (requires external mumble-website backend)

web_host.description: Interface for web interface binding (127.0.0.1 for localhost only)

web_key_path.description: TLS private key for web interface

web_port.description: Port for web interface (0 = auto-select; typically 8080)

allowRecording.description: Allow clients to use built-in recording feature.

allowhtml.description: Allow HTML in messages, comments, and descriptions.

allowping.description: Respond to UDP ping packets with server stats.

autobanAttempts.description: Connection attempts to trigger global ban (0 = disable).

autobanSuccessfulConnections.description: Count successful connections towards autoban limit.

autobanTime.description: Duration in seconds for global ban.

autobanTimeframe.description: Timeframe in seconds for autoban attempts.

bandwidth.description: Maximum speech bandwidth in bits per second.

bonjour.description: Announce server presence via bonjour service discovery.

channelcountlimit.description: Maximum number of channels per server (0 = unlimited).

channelname.description: Regular expression to validate channel names.

defaultchannel.description: Channel ID to automatically move new users into.

host.description: IP or hostname to bind to (empty = all addresses).

icesecretread.description: Plaintext secret for Ice read access.

icesecretwrite.description: Plaintext secret for Ice write access.

imagemessagelength.description: Maximum text+image message length in characters (0 = unlimited).

kdfiterations.description: Force specific PBKDF2 iterations (>0) or auto (-1).

legacypasswordhash.description: Use legacy password hash mode (1.2.4 and before).

listenersperchannel.description: Allowed listener proxies per channel (-1 = unlimited, 0 = disabled).

listenersperuser.description: Allowed listener proxies per user (-1 = unlimited, 0 = disabled).

logdays.description: Days to retain server logs in DB (0 = forever, -1 = disabled).

logfile.description: Log file path.

messageburst.description: Allowed command messages in short bursts per user.

messagelimit.description: Allowed command messages per second per user.

obfuscate.description: Randomize IP addresses in logs and user status.

opusthreshold.description: Percentage of Opus-supported users to force Opus usage.

pidfile.description: PID file path for daemon mode.

pluginmessageburst.description: Allowed plugin messages in short bursts per user.

pluginmessagelimit.description: Allowed plugin messages per second per user.

port.description: Port to bind TCP and UDP sockets.

rememberchannel.description: Remember and restore the last channel for returning users.

rememberchannelduration.description: Seconds to remember a user's last channel (0 = forever).

sendversion.description: Send server version and OS information to clients.

serverpassword.description: Password required to join the server.

sslCA.description: Path to SSL CA certificate file.

sslDHParams.description: Diffie-Hellman parameters file or named set.

sslKey.description: Path to SSL private key file.

sslPassPhrase.description: Passphrase for encrypted SSL private key.

suggestPositional.description: Alert users to enable positional audio.

textmessagelength.description: Maximum text message length in characters (0 = unlimited).

timeout.description: Seconds before disconnecting uncommunicating clients.

uname.description: OS user to switch to after startup if run as root.

username.description: Regular expression to validate user names.

users.description: Maximum concurrent clients allowed per virtual server.

Welcome to this server running Mumble.

To avoid conflict, test_mode should be handled separately or removed. Per manpage, -n has no test-mode function — only domain-number. Thus test_mode is unsupported and should be removed or reinterpreted. For clarity, set default false and note limitation.
