transport_mode.description: Transport mode. Use 'udp' for most deployments; 'ieee_1588' for legacy L2-only setups.

PTPD_OPTS.description: Additional command-line options to pass to ptpd (e.g., --interface eth0 --domain 0).

enabled.description: Start the PTP daemon on service startup.

enforce_src.description: If true, only accept ICMP packets from IPs listed in allowed_src_nets.

listen_interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Use 'auto' to let ptunnel auto-detect.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr.

max_idle_time.description: Maximum inactivity (in seconds) before a tunnel is forcibly closed.

max_tunnels.description: Maximum number of concurrent tunnels (TCP connections) allowed.

password.description: Password for securing the tunnel. Must be identical on both client and server.

ping_delay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) between consecutive ping packets. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more reliable through firewalls.

ping_dest_port.description: ICMP destination port used in the ICMP tunnel (must match between client and server). 0 = echo request.

ping_size.description: Size (in bytes) of ICMP payload. Larger sizes may improve throughput but increase fragmentation.

ping_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) value for outgoing ICMP packets. 0 = use system default.

remote_dst.description: Target remote IP address for the ICMP tunnel (required on the receiving end).

run_daemon.description: Set to "true" to enable the ptunnel daemon (must be set to 'true' to start the service).

tunnel_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which an idle tunnel is closed.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging? If true, logs at normal level. Use 0 or 1 explicitly for fine control.

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).

enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

IPRVersion.description: Path and filename for the IP reputation version file used with control socket reloads.

block_list.description: Path to the IP blocklist file where de-duplicated IPs are placed.

config_path.description: Path to the snort.conf file used for stub generation.

disablesid.description: Comma-separated list of SIDs to disable.

distro.description: Distribution type for precompiled shared object rule libraries.

dropsid.description: Comma-separated list of SIDs to drop.

enablesid.description: Comma-separated list of SIDs to enable.

ignore.description: Comma-separated list of rule categories to ignore from the tarball.

local_rules.description: Comma-separated full paths to local rules files to include in the sid-msg.map.

modifysid.description: Comma-separated list of SIDs to modify.

rule_path.description: Path to the .rules file containing all processed rules.

rule_url.description: One or more URLs to rule tarballs or blocklists, formatted as url|file|oinkcode.

sid_changelog.description: Path to the sid changelog file; optional.

sid_msg_version.description: Version of the sid-msg.map file to use (1 or 2); use 2 for barnyard2.2+.

snort_control.description: Path to the snort_control tool used for IP reputation reloads.

snort_path.description: Path to the snort binary used to generate stub files.

sorule_path.description: Path to the directory where .so shared object rule files are extracted.

temp_path.description: Temporary path for rule extraction and manipulation; must be writable, no trailing slash.

version.description: Version of snort being used; must include all four minor version numbers (e.g. 2.9.0.0), or suricata-x.x.x for Suricata.

delivery.ehlo.description: Name to use in EHLO/LHLO commands.

delivery.lmtp_socket.description: Path to LMTP Unix socket (only used if method=lmtp).

delivery.recipient.description: Message recipient. If empty, defaults to the username associated with the effective user ID.

headers.add_date.description: Ensure each message has a Date: header (add if missing).

headers.add_received.description: Add a 'Received:' header showing this forwarder's action.

headers.replace_from.description: If non-empty, overwrite the From: header with this email address.

imap.auth.description: Space-separated list of preferred authentication mechanisms (PLAIN, LOGIN, etc.).

imap.compress.description: Use the IMAP COMPRESS extension if advertised by the server.

imap.fetch_batch_size.description: Number of messages to fetch per IMAP batch to avoid timeouts.

imap.host.description: IMAP server hostname or IP address. Can optionally be enclosed in square brackets to force IP literal interpretation.

imap.mailbox.description: IMAP mailbox name to pull messages from (UTF-7 encoded and unquoted).

imap.password.description: IMAP login password (store securely in production — e.g., via secrets manager or file permissions).

imap.port.description: IMAP server port (143 for non-SSL, 993 for SSL).

imap.ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the IMAP connection (equivalent to type=imaps).

imap.username.description: IMAP login username (often full email address).

limits.max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum parallel message deliveries at once.

limits.max_message_size.description: Largest message size (in bytes) to process. 0 = unlimited.

limits.rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum messages delivered per minute. 0 = unlimited.

logging.level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn, error.

logging.log_file.description: Path to file where logs are written (empty = no file logging).

main.statefile.description: State file to track mailbox UIDVALIDITY and UIDNEXT values. Relative paths start from $XDG_DATA_HOME/pullimap or ~/.local/share/pullimap.

purge.retention_days.description: Retention period in days (≥24h accuracy due to IMAP SEARCH). 0 = delete immediately after delivery.

tls.SSL_CAfile.description: File containing trusted certificates for server verification.

tls.SSL_CApath.description: Directory to use for server certificate verification (must be in hash format).

tls.SSL_fingerprint.description: Space-separated list of acceptable fingerprints for server certificate SPKI (e.g., sha256$<hex>).

tls.SSL_hostname.description: Name to use for TLS SNI (Server Name Indication). Empty string disables SNI.

tls.SSL_protocol_max.description: Maximum SSL/TLS protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

tls.SSL_protocol_min.description: Minimum SSL/TLS protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

tls.SSL_verify.description: Whether to verify the server certificate chain and match its SAN/CN against host.

tls.ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying the SMTP/LMTP server certificate.

tls.enable.description: Enable TLS for outgoing SMTP/LMTP connections.

allow-exit.description: Allows the daemon to be exited on user request.

allow-module-loading.description: Allows loading additional modules after startup.

alternate-sample-rate.description: Alternate sample rate for hardware that doesn't support the default.

avoid-resampling.description: Disables automatic sample format and rate conversion.

cpu-limit.description: Installs a CPU load limiter to prevent system lockups.

daemonize.description: Detaches the daemon from the terminal after startup.

default-fragment-size-msec.description: Duration of each audio fragment in milliseconds.

default-fragments.description: Number of audio fragments/buffers in the playback/recording chain.

default-sample-format.description: Default sample format for audio streams.

default-script-file.description: Path to the default startup script to execute.

deferred-volume-extra-delay-usec.description: Additional delay in microseconds for deferred volume changes.

deferred-volume-safety-margin-usec.description: Safety margin in microseconds before volume changes are applied.

dl-search-path.description: Directory path for loading dynamic shared object modules.

enable-deferred-volume.description: Defers volume changes until playback/recording starts to avoid hardware issues.

enable-memfd.description: Enables Linux memfd shared memory for client-server communication.

enable-remixing.description: Allows remapping audio channels to different output channels.

enable-shm.description: Enables POSIX shared memory for client-server communication.

exit-idle-time.description: Seconds to wait after the last client disconnects before terminating.

fail.description: Fails startup if any command in the startup script fails.

flat-volumes.description: Disables per-application volume control to keep master volume flat.

high-priority.description: Attempts to acquire a high Unix nice level for better scheduling.

lfe-crossover-freq.description: Crossover frequency for LFE remixing in Hz. 0 disables.

load-default-script-file.description: Loads the default startup script file on launch.

local-server-type.description: Determines whether the server runs per-user or system-wide.

lock-memory.description: Prevents the daemon's memory from being swapped to disk.

log-backtrace.description: Number of stack frames to log with each message when greater than 0.

log-level.description: Sets the minimum log severity level to record.

log-meta.description: Includes source code location in log messages.

log-target.description: Specifies where log messages should be directed.

nice-level.description: Sets the Unix nice level for the daemon process.

realtime-priority.description: Sets the real-time scheduling priority level.

realtime-scheduling.description: Attempts to acquire real-time scheduling privileges.

remixing-consume-lfe.description: Consumes the LFE channel and mixes its content into other channels.

remixing-produce-lfe.description: Mixes low-frequency content into the LFE channel during remixing.

remixing-use-all-sink-channels.description: Uses all available sink channels when remixing.

resample-method.description: Audio resampler method to use by default.

rescue-streams.description: Reroutes streams to the default sink/source if the assigned one disappears.

rlimit-core.description: Limits the maximum size of core dump files.

rlimit-data.description: Limits the maximum size of the data segment.

rlimit-fsize.description: Limits the maximum size of files created by the daemon.

rlimit-locks.description: Limits the maximum number of file locks.

rlimit-memlock.description: Limits the maximum size of locked memory.

rlimit-msgqueue.description: Limits the maximum bytes of POSIX message queues.

rlimit-nice.description: Limits the maximum nice level decrement allowed.

rlimit-nofile.description: Limits the maximum number of open files.

rlimit-nproc.description: Limits the maximum number of processes.

rlimit-rss.description: Limits the maximum resident set size.

rlimit-rtprio.description: Limits the maximum real-time priority allowed.

rlimit-rttime.description: Limits the maximum CPU time in microseconds for real-time tasks.

rlimit-sigpending.description: Limits the maximum number of queued signals.

rlimit-stack.description: Limits the maximum size of the stack segment.

scache-idle-time.description: Seconds to wait after a cached sample is last used before unloading it.

shm-size-bytes.description: Size of the shared memory segment in bytes. 0 uses the system default.

system-instance.description: Runs PulseAudio as a system-wide daemon instead of per-user.

use-pid-file.description: Creates a PID file on startup.

host.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::'). Must be provided if `bind_tcp` is used.

port.description: Port number to listen on. Must be provided if `bind_tcp` is used.

access-log-config.description: Path to the access logging configuration file; comment out to disable access logging.

host.description: IP address or hostname to listen for clear-text HTTP connections.

port.description: Port to listen on for clear-text HTTP connections.

ssl-ca-cert.description: Path to the certificate authority (CA) certificate for SSL/TLS configuration.

ssl-cert.description: Path to the public certificate for SSL/TLS configuration.

ssl-host.description: IP address or hostname to listen on for HTTPS connections.

ssl-key.description: Path to the private key for SSL/TLS configuration.

ssl-port.description: Port to listen on for HTTPS connections.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

db_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use.

db_password.description: Password for the database user. Leave empty if using peer auth or SSL certs.

db_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to PostgreSQL.

db_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate used to verify the PostgreSQL server.

db_ssl_cert.description: Path to client certificate for PostgreSQL SSL authentication.

db_ssl_key.description: Path to client private key for PostgreSQL SSL authentication.

db_type.description: Database backend. PuppetDB supports only PostgreSQL.

db_user.description: Database user account PuppetDB will connect as.

ha_enabled.description: Enable high-availability mode (requires external database HA & load balancer).

http_host.description: Interface to bind the HTTP endpoint to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces (not recommended in production without TLS).

https_host.description: Interface to bind the HTTPS endpoint to.

https_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA cert used to verify client certificates (optional).

https_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate for HTTPS.

https_ssl_key.description: Path to private key for HTTPS. Must be world-readable if owned by root.

java_args.description: Java arguments passed to PuppetDB JVM (e.g., memory limits, GC options, JMX settings).

log_level.description: Verbosity of PuppetDB logging. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

max_connection_pool_size.description: Maximum number of database connections in the pool.

node_purge_ttl.description: Time after which inactive nodes are purged from the database.

query_max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of queued queries before rejecting.

query_workers.description: Number of threads used to process queries concurrently.

request_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a request (e.g., '30s', '5m').

api_v1_services_enabled.description: Route agent service requests through the v1 API (legacy); leave disabled for Puppet v7+

ca_enabled.description: Enable the Certificate Authority (CA) service; disable only for ca-bundle-only or proxy deployments

ca_max_serial_numbers.description: Maximum number of certificates to track in memory (increase for large infrastructures)

ca_name.description: Human-readable CA identifier (e.g., 'Puppet CA: prod-puppet-01'); leave empty for auto-generated

jvm_java_home.description: Path to Java 11+ runtime (JRE or JDK); Puppet Server requires Java 11–17

log_level.description: Root logging level: 'trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', or 'fatal'

puppet_server_hostname.description: Primary hostname for this Puppet Server (used as fallback for cert-hostname and CA name)

webserver_cert_hostname.description: Hostname used in SSL certificates for the web server (overrides cert-hostname in auth.conf); leave empty to use `puppet_server_hostname`

webserver_enabled.description: Enable the Puppet Server HTTP web interface (required for admin tools and status endpoints)

client_character_set.description: Default character set for MySQL client connections.

client_port.description: Default port used by MySQL client tools.

mysqld_bind_address.description: IP address MySQL listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces (ensure firewall is configured).

mysqld_binlog_enabled.description: Enable binary logging (required for replication and point-in-time recovery).

mysqld_binlog_format.description: Binary log format: STATEMENT, ROW, or MIXED. ROW is safest for replication.

mysqld_binlog_path.description: Base name/path for binary log files (without extension).

mysqld_character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

mysqld_collation_server.description: Default collation for the server (must match the character set).

mysqld_datadir.description: Directory where MySQL stores table data and system databases.

mysqld_expire_logs_days.description: Number of days after which binary logs are automatically purged.

mysqld_innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of the buffer pool used to cache InnoDB data and indexes. For dedicated DB servers, set to ~70–80% of RAM.

mysqld_innodb_flush_method.description: Method used to flush data to InnoDB data files and logs. Common: fsync, O_DIRECT.

mysqld_innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group. Larger values improve performance but increase crash recovery time.

mysqld_long_query_time.description: Threshold in seconds for queries to be logged as slow.

mysqld_max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or any generated/intermediate string. Must be a number + unit (e.g., 64M, 256M).

mysqld_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

mysqld_port.description: TCP port for MySQL server connections.

mysqld_query_cache_size.description: Total size of the query cache (deprecated in MySQL 8.0+; leave empty to omit.)

mysqld_query_cache_type.description: Query cache behavior: 0=OFF, 1=ON, 2=DEMAND. (Deprecated in MySQL 8.0+; leave empty to omit.)

mysqld_server_id.description: Unique server ID (1–4294967295). Required for replication; must be unique per server in the topology.

mysqld_slow_query_log_enabled.description: Enable slow query logging (for performance analysis).

mysqld_slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

mysqld_ssl_ca.description: Path to the CA certificate file for SSL (required if SSL enabled).

mysqld_ssl_cert.description: Path to the server certificate file for SSL.

mysqld_ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for MySQL connections.

mysqld_ssl_key.description: Path to the server private key file for SSL.

mysqld_thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads MySQL keeps cached for reuse. Higher values reduce thread creation overhead under high connection churn.

mysqld_wait_timeout.description: Number of seconds the server waits for activity on a non-interactive connection before closing it.

checkpoint_completion_target.description: Fraction of checkpoint interval over which checkpoint writes are spread (0.0–1.0). Higher values reduce I/O spikes.

default_text_search_config.description: Default text search configuration for full-text search operations.

lc_messages.description: Locale for message language. Must match available locale on the system.

listen_addresses.description: IP address(es) or hostname(s) PostgreSQL will listen on. Use '*' to listen on all interfaces. Example: '127.0.0.1,::1'.

log_directory.description: Directory where log files are stored. Must exist and be writable by the postgres user.

log_filename.description: Pattern for log filenames. Supports strftime-style placeholders (%Y, %m, %d, etc.).

log_min_duration_statement.description: Duration (in milliseconds) above which a statement will be logged. Set to -1 to disable.

log_min_messages.description: Threshold for messages written to the server log (e.g., DEBUG5, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, LOG).

log_timezone.description: Timezone used for timestamps in log messages. Prefer 'UTC' for consistency.

logging_collector.description: Enable the log collector to redirect log output into files instead of stderr.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

port.description: TCP port number for client connections.

shared_buffers.description: Amount of memory dedicated to PostgreSQL for caching data. Format: '<number><unit>' (e.g., 256MB, 1GB).

wal_buffers.description: Amount of shared memory used for WAL data. Usually auto-tuned, but can be set explicitly.

wal_segment_size.description: Size of each WAL segment file. Only change if recompiled with custom settings (rarely needed).

Umask.description: Umask values for newly created files and directories.

requirepass.description: Password required to connect to Sentinel.

sentinel.description: Base directive for various sentinel subcommands (monitor, auth-pass, etc.).

sentinel announce-ip.description: Announce a specific IP address in HELLO messages.

sentinel announce-port.description: Announce a specific TCP port in HELLO messages.

sentinel auth-pass.description: Password to authenticate with the monitored master and replicas.

sentinel auth-user.description: Username to authenticate to instances having ACL capabilities.

sentinel client-reconfig-script.description: Script called when master changes after a failover.

sentinel down-after-milliseconds.description: Milliseconds an instance should be unreachable to consider it down.

sentinel monitor.description: Tells Sentinel to monitor a master with name, ip, port, and quorum.

sentinel notification-script.description: Script called for any sentinel WARNING-level event.

sentinel parallel-syncs.description: Number of replicas that can be reconfigured simultaneously during failover.

sentinel sentinel-pass.description: Password for Sentinel to authenticate with other Sentinels.

sentinel sentinel-user.description: Username for Sentinel to authenticate with other Sentinels.

syslog-enabled.description: Enable logging to the system logger.

syslog-facility.description: Syslog facility (must be USER or between LOCAL0-LOCAL7).

acllog-max-len.description: Maximum number of entries retained in the in-memory ACL log.

active-expire-effort.description: CPU effort level allocated to the background expired key cleanup cycle.

always-show-logo.description: Force display of ASCII art logo on startup regardless of logging destination.

aof_load_truncated.description: Load AOF even if it appears truncated (prevents startup failure on partial writes).

aof_use_rdb_preamble.description: Prefix AOF with RDB snapshot for faster load (recommended).

appendfsync.description: Sync policy: always, everysec, no. Trade-off between durability & performance.

appendonly.description: Enable AOF persistence (recommended over RDB alone for durability).

auto_aof_rewrite_min_size.description: Minimum AOF size required to trigger rewrite (e.g., '64mb', '128mb').

auto_aof_rewrite_percentage.description: Trigger AOF rewrite when size grows by this % over last rewrite.

bind.description: IP address(es) Redis will bind to (space-separated for multiple). Use '0.0.0.0' to bind to all interfaces (⚠️ insecure unless firewall-protection is applied).

cluster_config_file.description: Filename for cluster configuration (auto-generated, do not edit manually).

cluster_enabled.description: Enable Redis Cluster mode (requires multiple nodes).

cluster_node_timeout.description: Cluster node timeout in milliseconds before marking a node as failed.

daemonize.description: Run Redis as a background daemon (recommended for production).

databases.description: Total number of available database namespaces.

dir.description: Working directory for RDB/AOF files and persistence data.

disable-thp.description: Disables kernel Transparent Huge Pages for the Redis process to avoid fork latency.

io-threads.description: Number of I/O threads to handle client socket reads and writes; setting to 1 disables threading.

io-threads-do-reads.description: Enables threaded I/O for client reads and protocol parsing.

latency_monitor_threshold.description: Log events taking ≥ this many milliseconds (0 = disabled).

lazyfree-lazy-eviction.description: Controls whether key deletion during memory eviction is handled asynchronously to avoid blocking the main thread.

lazyfree-lazy-expire.description: Controls whether key expiration is handled asynchronously to prevent main thread blocking.

lazyfree-lazy-server-del.description: Controls whether internal server-side key deletions are handled asynchronously.

lazyfree-lazy-user-del.description: Modifies the default DEL command behavior to act asynchronously (like UNLINK).

lazyfree-lazy-user-flush.description: Controls the default asynchronous deletion behavior for FLUSHDB/FLUSHALL when no SYNC/ASYNC flag is passed.

logfile.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to stderr.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logs. Options: debug, verbose, notice, warning.

masterauth.description: Password used when authenticating to a master (for replication).

maxclients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

maxmemory.description: Maximum memory Redis can use (e.g., '2gb', '512mb', '0' = unlimited). Required for eviction policies to take effect.

maxmemory-eviction-tenacity.description: Control the aggressiveness of background memory reclamation during eviction.

maxmemory-policy.description: Memory eviction strategy when maxmemory limit is reached.

maxmemory-samples.description: Number of keys sampled for approximating LRU, LFU, and TTL eviction algorithms.

maxmemory_policy.description: Eviction policy when maxmemory is reached (e.g., allkeys-lru, volatile-ttl, allkeys-random).

maxmemory_samples.description: Number of samples for LRU and TTL eviction algorithms. Higher = more accuracy, more CPU.

no-appendfsync-on-rewrite.description: Disables fsync during background save/rewrite to prevent I/O blocking at the cost of potential data loss.

no_appendfsync_on_rewrite.description: Defer fsync during BGSAVE/AOF rewrite (improves latency but risks data loss in crash).

notify_keyspace_events.description: Enable pub/sub for key events (e.g., 'AKE' = all events; empty = disabled).

oom-score-adj.description: Controls how Redis adjusts the kernel OOM killer score based on process role.

oom-score-adj-values.description: Space-separated OOM score values for master, replica, and background child processes.

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for process management.

port.description: TCP port for non-TLS connections. Set to 0 if only using TLS.

proc-title-template.description: Template string used to construct the process title.

protected-mode.description: Enables a security layer to prevent unauthorized internet access without authentication or binding.

rdb-del-sync-files.description: Delete RDB files created during replication when persistence is fully disabled.

rdbchecksum.description: Append a CRC64 checksum to RDB files for corruption detection.

rdbcompression.description: Compress RDB files using LZF to save disk space.

repl-disable-tcp-nodelay.description: Disable TCP_NODELAY on the replica socket after SYNC to save bandwidth.

repl-diskless-load.description: Strategy for loading RDB data directly from the network socket during replication.

repl-diskless-sync.description: Use diskless (socket) transmission instead of disk-backed files for replication sync.

repl-diskless-sync-delay.description: Delay in seconds before starting diskless replication sync to allow more replicas to connect.

replica-lazy-flush.description: Controls whether database flushing during replica synchronization is handled asynchronously.

replica-priority.description: Priority score for Sentinel replica promotion (lower is better; 0 disables promotion).

replica-read-only.description: Force replica instances to operate in read-only mode.

replica-serve-stale-data.description: Allow replicas to serve potentially out-of-date data during synchronization.

replica_announce_ip.description: Public IP to announce to clients as this replica's address (e.g., for NAT/containers).

replica_announce_port.description: Public port to announce as this replica's port (when replica-announce-ip is set).

replicaof.description: Master node to replicate from in format 'host port'. Empty string = standalone/master.

requirepass.description: Password required for client authentication (⚠️ avoid in plaintext in production — use ACLs instead).

sanitize-dump-payload.description: Perform full data structure sanitation when loading RDB or RESTORE payloads.

sentinel_master_ip.description: IP address of the master to monitor (only used in Sentinel config).

sentinel_master_port.description: Port of the master to monitor.

sentinel_mode.description: Enable Redis Sentinel mode for high availability (monitors masters/replicas).

sentinel_quorum.description: Number of Sentinels that must agree to detect a master failure.

set-proc-title.description: Modify the OS process title with runtime Redis information.

slowlog_max_len.description: Maximum number of entries kept in slowlog.

stop-writes-on-bgsave-error.description: Stop accepting writes if background RDB snapshot fails.

supervised.description: Method to signal process readiness to a system supervisor.

tcp-backlog.description: TCP listen() backlog size for incoming connections.

tcp-keepalive.description: TCP keepalive period in seconds to detect dead peers and keep connections alive.

MUTE_TX_ON_RX.description: Mute transmitter during RX squelch open.

NAME.description: Module name (matches module namespace in event scripts).

OB_AFSK_ENABLE.description: Enable reception of metadata via out-of-band AFSK.

OB_AFSK_LEVEL.description: Out-of-band AFSK modulation level in dBFS.

OB_AFSK_TX_DELAY.description: Milliseconds to send AFSK flag bytes before data transmission.

OB_AFSK_VOICE_GAIN.description: Voice audio gain adjustment for OB AFSK transmission.

ONLINE_CMD.description: DTMF command to toggle online/offline mode.

OPEN_ON_1750.description: Enables 1750Hz tone burst activation with specified ms delay.

OPEN_ON_SEL5.description: Selective tone sequence (4-25 digits) to open repeater.

OPEN_ON_SQL.description: Minimum milliseconds squelch open to activate repeater.

OPEN_ON_SQL_AFTER_RPT_CLOSE.description: Seconds after repeater close to activate on SQL.

OPEN_SQL_FLANK.description: Triggers repeater activation on SQL open/close.

OPUS_ENC_BITRATE.description: Bit-rate in bps for the Opus encoder.

OPUS_ENC_COMPLEXITY.description: Complexity level (0-10) for the Opus encoder.

OPUS_ENC_FRAME_SIZE.description: Frame size in milliseconds for Opus encoder.

OPUS_ENC_VBR.description: Enable variable bit-rate encoding for Opus.

PEAK_METER.description: Enable peak metering to detect audio distortion.

PHONETIC_SPELLING.description: Use phonetic or non-phonetic spelling for callsign/word announcements.

PLUGIN_NAME.description: Plugin name (determines the ModuleXxx.so file loaded).

PORT.description: TCP/UDP port number for the reflector server.

PREAMP.description: Amplification applied to the incoming signal in dB.

PREEMPHASIS.description: Enable preemphasis filter for FM modulation.

PTT_HANGTIME.description: PTT hangtime in milliseconds after transmit ends.

PTT_PIN.description: Pin(s) in serial port or GPIO used for PTT control.

PTT_PORT.description: Serial port that the PTT is connected to.

PTT_PTY.description: Path to PTY slave softlink for external PTT script.

PTT_TYPE.description: Type of hardware used to control the PTT.

PTY_PATH.description: Path to a PTY for external APRS packet injection.

QSO_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds idle before closing a recording after a QSO.

RAW_AUDIO_UDP_DEST.description: Destination IP and port for raw audio streaming over UDP.

RECEIVERS.description: Comma-separated list of receivers used by the voter.

REC_DIR.description: Directory for QSO recorded audio files.

REPORT_CTCSS.description: CTCSS frequency to report upon manual ident (e.g., 136.5).

REVOTE_INTERVAL.description: Interval in milliseconds between voter revotes.

RGR_SOUND_ALWAYS.description: Always send roger sound after squelch close.

RGR_SOUND_DELAY.description: Milliseconds to wait before a roger beep. -1 disables.

RX.description: Section name of the receiver configuration.

RX_ID.description: Single char identifying the receiver for event scripts.

RX_SWITCH_DELAY.description: Delay in milliseconds before voter performs a receiver switch.

SAMPLE_RATE.description: Sample rate used by the RTL dongle.

SEL5_MACRO_RANGE.description: Comma-separated SEL5 frequency sequence range to map to macros.

SERIAL_PIN.description: Pin on serial port for hardware squelch detection.

SERIAL_SET_PINS.description: Statically set pins (RTS/DTR) on serial port.

SHORT_ANNOUNCE_ENABLE.description: Enables custom announcement during short ID.

SHORT_ANNOUNCE_FILE.description: Full path to a file for custom announcements during short ID.

SHORT_CW_ID_ENABLE.description: Enables CW ID announcement during short ID.

SHORT_IDENT_INTERVAL.description: Minutes between short identifications (divisor of LONG_IDENT_INTERVAL). 0 disables.

SHORT_VOICE_ID_ENABLE.description: Enables voice ID announcement during short ID.

SIGLEV_BOGUS_THRESH.description: Threshold above which signal level estimation is considered bogus.

SIGLEV_CLOSE_THRESH.description: Squelch close threshold for the SIGLEV squelch detector.

SIGLEV_DEFAULT.description: Default signal level set on startup by the SIM detector.

SIGLEV_DET.description: Type of signal level detector to use.

SIGLEV_MAX.description: Maximum signal level used by the SIM signal level detector.

SIGLEV_MIN.description: Minimum signal level used by the SIM signal level detector.

SIGLEV_OFFSET.description: Offset of the signal level detector.

SIGLEV_OPEN_THRESH.description: Squelch open threshold for the SIGLEV squelch detector.

SIGLEV_RAND_INTERVAL.description: Interval in milliseconds between random signal level changes by SIM.

SIGLEV_SLOPE.description: Slope/gain of the signal level detector.

SIGLEV_TOGGLE_INTERVAL.description: Interval in milliseconds for SIM to toggle between min and max signal levels.

SIM_TONE_FQ.description: Frequency in Hz of the simulated tone.

SIM_TONE_PWR.description: Power in dB of the simulated tone.

SOFT_TIME.description: Soft break time to prevent abrupt cuts.

SPEEX_DEC_ENHANCER.description: Enable perceptual enhancer in Speex decoder.

SPEEX_ENC_ABR.description: Target bit-rate for Speex average bit-rate encoding.

SPEEX_ENC_BITRATE.description: Bit-rate in bps for the Speex encoder.

SPEEX_ENC_COMPLEXITY.description: Complexity level (0-10) for the Speex encoder.

SPEEX_ENC_FRAMES_PER_PACKET.description: Number of Speex frames per network packet.

SPEEX_ENC_QUALITY.description: Quality level (0-10) for the Speex encoder.

SPEEX_ENC_VBR.description: Enable variable bit-rate encoding for Speex.

SQL_CLOSE_REVOTE_DELAY.description: Delay in milliseconds after squelch close before voter votes again.

SQL_DELAY.description: Delay in ms before signaling squelch open.

SQL_DET.description: Type of squelch detector to use.

SQL_EXTENDED_HANGTIME.description: Extended hangtime in ms for weak signals.

SQL_EXTENDED_HANGTIME_THRESH.description: Signal threshold to activate extended hangtime.

SQL_FLAP_SUP_MAX_COUNT.description: Max consecutive short squelch opens before shutdown.

SQL_FLAP_SUP_MIN_TIME.description: Minimum ms for squelch flapping suppression.

SQL_HANGTIME.description: Milliseconds squelch stays open after closing.

SQL_START_DELAY.description: Milliseconds to ignore SQL detection after TX.

SQL_TAIL_ELIM.description: Duration in milliseconds for squelch tail elimination.

STATE_PTY.description: Path to a UNIX 98 PTY for state events.

STATUS_SERVER_LIST.description: Space-separated list of EchoLink status servers (host:port).

TIMEOUT.description: Seconds before resetting QSO recorder state.

TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.description: Specifies the format of log timestamp using strftime.

TIME_FORMAT.description: Format of time announced on the radio interface.

TONE.description: CTCSS sub-audible tone or tone burst (0 = disabled, e.g., 136).

TONE_SIGLEV_LEVEL.description: Output level in percent of maximum for transmitted signal level tone.

TONE_SIGLEV_MAP.description: Mapping of tones to signal level values for TONE signal level detector.

TRANSMITTERS.description: Comma-separated list of transmitters in a multi transmitter section.

TX.description: Section name of the transmitter configuration.

TX_CTCSS.description: Comma-separated list of times to transmit CTCSS tone.

TX_DELAY.description: Delay in milliseconds before transmitting audio after PTT is on.

TYPE.description: The type of logic core this is.

VOTING_DELAY.description: Delay in milliseconds before voter selects a receiver after squelch open.

VOX_THRESH.description: Threshold for open squelch detection in VOX.

WBRX.description: Wide-band receiver configuration section connected to the Ddr receiver.

XVRTR_OFFSET.description: Frequency offset introduced by a transverter.

BAND_AND_CHANNEL.description: Channel setting like 'PC Only','Crosslink', or frequency+mode+squelch specification.

CALLSIGN_AND_USER.description: Your callsign and user name used during registration (e.g., "1234, Bob").

CITY_CITY_PART.description: City and city part or country part and city, separated by '-'. Example: "City - Street".

DESCRIPTION.description: Custom extra information about the node.

DISABLE_RF.description: Disable sending voice from FRN to RIG until manually re-enabled via DTMF.

DYN_PASSWORD.description: Password provided by FRN on registration.

EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Your email address used during registration.

FRN_DEBUG.description: Enable extensive module logging including FRN request/response printout.

NET.description: Network (room) where to connect (up to 32 per server).

SERVER.description: FRN server hostname or ip address.

SERVER_BACKUP.description: FRN backup server hostname or ip address.

VERSION.description: Identify itself as a FRN client with this version.

FIFO_LEN.description: The length, in seconds, of the FIFO audio buffer where audio is recorded to.

REPEAT_DELAY.description: A time, in milliseconds, that the parrot module will wait after squelch close before playing back the recorded message.

FQ.description: Define the lower and upper frequencies for the band in kHz on the form lower-upper.

FQ_DEFAULT.description: Default frequency in kHz for a band, used to set the initial frequency for a band selected through a shortcut.

MODULATION.description: Specify which modulation to use. For a list of valid modulations, have a look at the documentation for the MODULATION variable in the svxlink.conf(5) manual page.

RX.description: Specify a receiver configuration section in the same way that it is done in the rest of SvxLink.

RX_TIMEOUT.description: Specify a timeout, in seconds, after which the audio is suppressed from the receiver.

SHIFT.description: Specify the repeater shift (e.g. split transmit frequency) in kHz.

SHORTCUT.description: Define a shortcut for a band. The shortcut may be any positive number except 0-9 which is reserved for module commands.

TX.description: Specify a transmitter configuration section in the same way that it is done in the rest of SvxLink.

AddHeader.description: Configures HTTP request headers to be added to outgoing HTTP requests.

Allow.description: An IP address, range, hostname, domain, or TLD of clients allowed to access Tinyproxy.

Anonymous.description: Enables anonymous proxying; listed headers are allowed through, all others are denied.

BasicAuth.description: Configures HTTP Basic Authentication username and password for accessing the proxy.

Bind.description: Specifies which address Tinyproxy binds to for outgoing connections; may be specified multiple times.

BindSame.description: If yes, Tinyproxy binds the outgoing connection to the IP address of the incoming connection.

ConnectPort.description: Specifies the ports allowed for the CONNECT method; use 0 to disable CONNECT altogether.

DefaultErrorFile.description: The HTML template file returned when an error occurs for which no specific error file has been set.

Deny.description: An IP address, range, hostname, domain, or TLD of clients denied access to Tinyproxy.

DisableViaHeader.description: If yes, Tinyproxy does not add the Via header to requests.

ErrorFile.description: Controls which HTML file Tinyproxy returns for a given HTTP error; takes an error number and file location.

Filter.description: The location of the file containing filter rules, one rule per line.

FilterCaseSensitive.description: If yes, filter rules are matched in a case sensitive manner.

FilterDefaultDeny.description: If yes, the filter list acts as a whitelist; denies everything not matched by a rule.

FilterExtended.description: Deprecated. If yes, extended POSIX regular expressions are used for matching filter rules.

FilterType.description: The type of matching used for filter rules: bre, ere, or fnmatch.

FilterURLs.description: If yes or on, filtering is performed for URLs rather than domains.

Group.description: The group which the Tinyproxy process should run as, after the initial port-binding.

Listen.description: The address Tinyproxy listens for connections on; by default it listens on all available interfaces.

LogFile.description: The location of the file to which Tinyproxy writes its debug output.

LogLevel.description: Sets the log level; messages from the set level and above are logged.

MaxClients.description: The highest number of processes (threads) Tinyproxy will create for connected clients.

PidFile.description: The location of the file where the main Tinyproxy process stores its process ID.

Port.description: The port which the Tinyproxy service will listen on.

ReverseBaseURL.description: The URL used to access this reverse proxy; used to rewrite HTTP redirects.

ReverseMagic.description: If yes, Tinyproxy uses a cookie to track reverse proxy mappings.

ReverseOnly.description: If yes, turns off the normal proxy when using Tinyproxy as a reverse proxy.

ReversePath.description: Configures reverse proxy support; maps a local path to a remote URL.

StatFile.description: The HTML file that Tinyproxy sends when a request for the stathost is received.

StatHost.description: The host name or IP address treated as the stat host; requests for it return an internal statistics page.

Syslog.description: If on, Tinyproxy writes debug messages to syslog instead of a log file; mutually exclusive with LogFile.

Timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds of inactivity before a connection is closed.

Upstream.description: Sets up rules for deciding whether an upstream proxy server is to be used, based on the host or domain.

User.description: The user which the Tinyproxy process should run as, after the initial port-binding.

ViaProxyName.description: The string used as the host name in the Via header instead of the real host name.

XTinyproxy.description: If yes, Tinyproxy adds an X-Tinyproxy header containing the client's IP address to the request.

default_video_model.description: Default graphics adapter for VMs. 'qxl' works well with SPICE; 'virtio' for minimal overhead.

emulator.description: Override the default QEMU emulator binary (e.g., 'qemu-system-aarch64'). Leave empty to auto-detect.

group.description: Group ownership for QEMU processes.

hotplug.description: Enable hotplug for disks and NICs. Required for dynamic resource scaling.

io_threads.description: Number of dedicated I/O worker threads. Higher values may improve I/O throughput on multi-core systems.

live_snapshot.description: Enable taking snapshots of running VMs without downtime.

log_file.description: Path to the log file when log_output is set to 'file'.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=none, 1=error, 2=info, 3=debug. Use 2 for general troubleshooting.

log_output.description: Where to send QEMU logs: 'file', 'syslog', or 'stderr'.

max_vcpus.description: Maximum virtual CPUs allowed per guest. Adjust based on host CPU topology.

memory_backing.description: Memory backing mode for VMs. 'hugepages' improves performance on large guests.

migration.description: Enable or disable VM live migration capability.

migration_address.description: IP address for incoming migration traffic. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

migration_port.description: Base port for migration traffic. Migrating VMs use sequential ports in the range.

migration_ports.description: Number of ports (starting from migration_port) reserved for concurrent migrations.

monitor_protocol.description: Protocol used for QEMU monitor communication. 'json' is recommended for automation.

monitor_stdin.description: Enable QEMU monitor on stdin. Disable to prevent accidental console access.

netns.description: Run QEMU processes in a private network namespace. Isolates network stack for security.

numa_auto_allocation.description: Automatically allocate guest memory to NUMA nodes. Disable for manual NUMA pinning.

sandbox.description: Enable seccomp sandboxing to restrict system calls. Keep enabled for security.

seccomp_sandbox.description: Enable seccomp filters to restrict system calls. Keep enabled unless troubleshooting.

shared_block.description: Allow multiple VMs to share the same block device. Requires external coordination (e.g., GFS2).

spice_listen.description: IP address on which SPICE servers listen. Similar to VNC, restrict to '127.0.0.1' for security.

spice_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for SPICE remote desktop connections.

tee.description: Enable support for Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) devices (e.g., Intel TDX).

tpm.description: Enable TPM (Trusted Platform Module) support in guests.

uefi_firmware.description: Enable UEFI firmware support (OVMF/AAVMF). Required for UEFI guests.

use_cgroups.description: Use cgroups v2 for CPU and memory resource control. Required for advanced QoS.

user.description: User account under which QEMU processes run. Use 'qemu' or a dedicated non-root user for security.

vhost_user.description: Enable vhost-user (userspace virtio backend) support for high-performance networking.

vnc_listen.description: IP address on which VNC servers listen. '127.0.0.1' restricts to local host; '0.0.0.0' allows all interfaces.

vnc_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for VNC remote desktop connections. Required for secure access.

callout-info.description: Callout information string to match; may contain one '*' wildcard.

description.description: Key description to match; may contain one '*' wildcard.

op.description: Operation type; only 'create' is currently supported.

prog.description: Program to execute; must be fully qualified path; may be prefixed with '|' for pipe mode.

type.description: Key type to match; may contain one '*' wildcard.

nameserver.description: IP address of a DNS name server to query.

options.description: Resolver option settings (comma- or space-separated list of keywords).

search.description: Domain search list for hostname lookup.

sortlist.description: IP address/netmask pairs to sort addresses returned by gethostbyname.

bzip-blocksize.description: bzip2 block size multiplier (actual block size = value × 100000); 0 means no compression.

bzip-small.description: When true, reduce bzip memory usage at cost of compression ratio.

compiler-directory.description: Specify an alternative directory that contains HLL to CIL compilers.

disable-genhomedircon.description: Control whether the genhomedircon function is executed during semanage commands.

expand-check.description: Whether or not to check 'neverallow' rules during semanage command execution.

file-mode.description: Permission mode for run-time policy files.

handle-unknown.description: Override kernel behavior for handling permissions defined in the kernel but missing from the actual policy.

ignore-module-cache.description: Whether or not to ignore the cache of CIL modules compiled from HLL.

ignoredirs.description: List of directories, separated by ';', to ignore when setting up users' homedirs.

module-store.description: Specify how the SELinux Management library should interact with the SELinux policy store.

optimize-policy.description: When true, optimize the kernel policy upon rebuilds.

policy-version.description: When generating the policy, set the policy version to a specific value.

remove-hll.description: When true, remove HLL files after compiling into CIL.

root.description: Specify an alternative root path to use for the store.

save-linked.description: Control whether the previously linked module is saved after a successful commit to the policy store.

save-previous.description: Control whether the previous module directory is saved after a successful commit to the policy store.

store-root.description: Specify an alternative store_root path to use.

target-platform.description: The target platform to generate policies for.

usepasswd.description: Whether or not to enable the use of getpwent() to obtain a list of home directories to label.

exclusive.description: Only single login session will be allowed for the user; processes will be killed on logout.

ignore.description: Module will never return PAM_SUCCESS for the user; returns PAM_IGNORE if SELinux enforcing, else PAM_AUTH_ERR.

allow_suspicious_udfs.description: Allows use of user-defined functions with only one symbol x() without init/deinit.

alter_algorithm.description: Implied ALGORITHM for ALTER TABLE when no clause specified.

analyze_max_length.description: Max column length (bytes) for automatic ANALYZE TABLE statistics collection.

analyze_sample_percentage.description: Percentage of rows to sample for ANALYZE TABLE statistics.

autocommit.description: If ON, queries are committed immediately.

automatic_sp_privileges.description: If ON, creator of stored routine automatically gets ALTER/EXECUTE privileges.

back_log.description: Number of outstanding connection requests allowed in listen queue.

big_tables.description: If ON, temporary tables are saved to disk instead of memory.

bind_address.description: Address(es) the server listens on for TCP/IP connections.

block_encryption_mode.description: Default block encryption mode for AES_ENCRYPT()/AES_DECRYPT().

character_set_client.description: Character set used for queries from client.

character_set_collations.description: Overrides for default collations per character set.

character_set_connection.description: Character set used for number-to-string conversion and literals without introducer.

character_set_database.description: Character set of the default database.

character_set_filesystem.description: Character set used for converting filenames.

character_set_results.description: Character set used for results/error messages to client.

character_set_server.description: Default character set for the server.

character_set_system.description: Character set used for storing identifiers.

character_sets_dir.description: Directory where character set definitions are installed.

check_constraint_checks.description: If OFF, constraint checks are disabled (e.g., during data loading).

collation_connection.description: Collation used for the connection character set.

collation_database.description: Collation used for the default database.

collation_server.description: Default collation used by the server.

completion_type.description: Transaction completion behavior (e.g., chain or release).

concurrent_insert.description: Controls concurrent INSERT behavior for MyISAM tables.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for connect packet before aborting handshake.

core_file.description: If ON, write a core-file on crashes.

datadir.description: Directory where database files are stored.

debug.description: Debug trace options (debug builds only).

default_password_lifetime.description: Global password expiration policy in days (0 = disabled).

default_regex_flags.description: Regex flags for default PCRE behavior.

default_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for new tables.

default_table_type.description: Deprecated alias of default_storage_engine; removed in MariaDB 5.5.

default_tmp_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for temporary tables (NULL = use default_storage_engine).

delayed_insert_limit.description: Max rows inserted with INSERT DELAYED before checking for SELECTs.

delayed_insert_timeout.description: Seconds INSERT DELAYED handler waits before terminating.

delayed_queue_size.description: Rows per table queued for INSERT DELAYED.

disconnect_on_expired_password.description: Controls handling of expired passwords for non-sandbox-aware clients.

div_precision_increment.description: Digits added to decimal result precision in division.

encrypt_tmp_disk_tables.description: If ON, encrypt internal on-disk temporary tables.

encrypt_tmp_files.description: If ON, encrypt temporary files (e.g., for filesort).

enforce_storage_engine.description: Force use of a specific storage engine (session scope).

eq_range_index_dive_limit.description: Limit for using index statistics instead of index dives in equality ranges.

error_count.description: Number of errors from last statement in session.

expensive_subquery_limit.description: Max rows a subquery may examine to be used in constant optimization.

explicit_defaults_for_timestamp.description: If ON, TIMESTAMP columns default to NULL instead of NOT NULL.

external_user.description: External OS user name (for external auth plugins).

flush.description: If ON, flush all changes to disk after each statement.

flush_time.description: Interval (seconds) for automatic table sync/cleanup (0 = disabled).

foreign_key_checks.description: If ON, InnoDB foreign key constraints are enforced.

ft_boolean_syntax.description: Operators supported in IN BOOLEAN MODE full-text searches.

ft_max_word_len.description: Max word length for MyISAM full-text index.

ft_min_word_len.description: Min word length for MyISAM full-text index.

ft_query_expansion_limit.description: Number of top matches for WITH QUERY EXPANSION.

ft_stopword_file.description: File containing stopwords for MyISAM full-text search.

general_log.description: If ON, general query log is enabled.

general_log_file.description: Name of the general query log file.

have_crypt.description: Whether crypt() system call is available.

have_csv.description: CSV engine support status; removed in MariaDB 10.0.

have_ndbcluster.description: NDB Cluster support; removed in MariaDB 10.0.

have_rtree_keys.description: RTREE index support for spatial data.

histogram_size.description: Number of histogram buckets (bytes or buckets depending on histogram_type).

histogram_type.description: Type of histograms created by ANALYZE.

host_cache_size.description: Number of host names to cache for DNS lookup.

hostname.description: Server host name.

idle_readonly_transaction_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for idle read-only transactions before killing connection.

idle_transaction_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for idle transactions before killing connection.

idle_write_transaction_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for idle write transactions before killing connection.

ignore_db_dirs.description: Directories to ignore as database paths (comma-separated list).

in_predicate_conversion_threshold.description: Min number of elements in IN list to trigger conversion to subquery.

in_transaction.description: 1 if a transaction is in progress (session-only, read-only).

init_connect.description: SQL statements executed per client connection.

init_file.description: File with SQL statements executed on server startup.

insert_id.description: Value to use for next AUTO_INCREMENT insert.

interactive_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for activity on interactive connections before closing.

join_buffer_space_limit.description: Max size (bytes) of the join buffer per query.

keep_files_on_create.description: If ON, prevent overwriting .MYD/.MYI files during MyISAM table creation.

large_pages.description: If ON, use large pages for buffer allocations.

lc_time_names.description: Locale for language in date/time functions.

local_infile.description: If ON, LOCAL is allowed in LOAD DATA INFILE.

lock_wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for metadata locks before timing out.

locked_in_memory.description: If ON, mariadbd was started with --memlock.

log.description: Deprecated alias of general_log; removed in MariaDB 10.0.

log_disabled_statements.description: Statement types excluded from general log.

log_error.description: Name of the error log file.

log_output.description: Where to store general/slow query log output.

log_queries_not_using_indexes.description: If ON, log queries not using indexes to slow query log.

log_slow_disabled_statements.description: Statement types excluded from slow query log.

log_slow_filter.description: Filter criteria for slow query log entries.

log_slow_max_warnings.description: Max number of warnings per statement logged to slow query log.

log_slow_min_examined_row_limit.description: Skip logging queries that examine fewer rows than this limit.

log_slow_queries.description: Deprecated alias of slow_query_log; removed in MariaDB 10.0.

log_slow_query.description: If ON, slow query log is enabled (alias: slow_query_log).

log_slow_query_file.description: Name of the slow query log file.

log_slow_query_time.description: Seconds threshold for slow query logging.

long_query_time.description: Seconds threshold for slow query logging (not explicitly listed; inferred).

lower_case_table_names.description: How table names are stored and compared (0 = case-sensitive).

max_allowed_packet.description: Max size of packet or any string.

max_binlog_size.description: Max size of binary log file.

max_connect_errors.description: Max failed connection attempts before host is blocked.

max_connections.description: Max number of simultaneous client connections.

max_delayed_threads.description: Max number of INSERT DELAYED threads per table.

max_error_count.description: Max number of errors/warnings stored per statement.

max_heap_table_size.description: Max size of in-memory temporary tables.

max_join_size.description: Max number of rows that can be examined by a join.

max_length_for_sort_data.description: Max bytes of sort data to keep for sorting.

max_seeks_for_key.description: Assumed max index seeks for query optimization.

max_sort_length.description: Max bytes used when sorting BLOB/TEXT.

max_tmp_tables.description: Max number of temporary tables per client.

max_write_lock_count.description: After this many write locks, allow pending reads to run.

memory_use_high_watermark.description: Memory watermark for session memory tracking.

metadata_locks_hash_instances.description: Number of metadata lock hash instances.

min_examined_row_limit.description: Min rows examined for query to be logged to slow log.

net_buffer_length.description: Buffer size for initial communication packet.

net_read_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for more data from connection before aborting read.

net_retry_count.description: Max number of retries for network read/write.

net_write_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for write to complete before aborting.

new.description: Deprecated option to enable old behavior.

old_alter_table.description: Use old-style ALTER TABLE (deprecated alias of alter_algorithm=COPY).

optimizer_trace_features.description: Features to include in optimizer trace.

partition_prune_count_only.description: Only count partitions (not list values) when pruning.

performance_schema.description: If ON, Performance Schema is enabled.

performance_schema_accounts_size.description: Number of Performance Schema account rows.

performance_schema_events_stages_history.description: Size of stages history long table.

performance_schema_events_statements_his.description: Size of statements history long table.

performance_schema_events_transactions_h.description: Size of transactions history long table.

performance_schema_events_waits_history_.description: Size of waits history long table.

performance_schema_hosts_size.description: Number of Performance Schema host rows.

performance_schema_max_connection_events.description: Max roles per connection events stack.

performance_schema_session_connect_attrs.description: Max bytes per session connection attributes.

performance_schema_users_size.description: Number of Performance Schema user rows.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file.

port.description: TCP/IP port number for server connections.

preload_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer used for MyISAM table preloading.

profiling.description: If ON, statement profiling is enabled.

profiling_history_size.description: Number of profiles retained for SHOW PROFILE.

query_alloc_block_size.description: Allocation block size for query parsing.

query_cache_limit.description: Max size of result cached in query cache.

query_cache_min_res_unit.description: Min size of memory blocks allocated in query cache.

query_cache_wlock_invalidate.description: If ON, invalidate query cache on write lock.

query_prealloc_size.description: Initial size of query memory buffer.

rand_seed1.description: Seed for RAND() in current session.

rand_seed2.description: Seed for RAND() in current session.

range_alloc_block_size.description: Allocation block size for range optimization.

read_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for sequential table scans.

read_only.description: If ON, server operates in read-only mode.

read_rnd_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for reading rows after sorting.

relay_log_index.description: Name of relay log index file.

relay_log_info_file.description: Name of relay log info file.

relay_log_purge.description: If ON, old relay logs are purged.

relay_log_space_limit.description: Max total size of relay logs.

report_host.description: Host name to report to master for replication.

report_password.description: Password to report to master for replication.

report_port.description: Port to report to master for replication.

report_user.description: User name to report to master for replication.

require_secure_transport.description: If ON, require TLS/SSL for connections.

rpl_semi_sync_master_enabled.description: If ON, enable semi-synchronous replication on master.

rpl_semi_sync_master_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for semi-sync ACK on master.

rpl_semi_sync_master_wait_for_slave_coun.description: Number of slaves to wait for semi-sync ACK.

rpl_semi_sync_master_wait_no_slave.description: If ON, wait for at least one slave ACK.

rpl_semi_sync_master_wait_point.description: Wait point for semi-sync on master.

rpl_semi_sync_slave_enabled.description: If ON, enable semi-sync replication on slave.

select_full_join.description: Number of full joins (no index used).

select_full_range_join.description: Number of range joins using index.

server_id_bits.description: Number of bits used for server ID in GTID.

session_track_schema.description: If ON, track schema changes in session.

session_track_state_change.description: If ON, track state changes in session.

session_track_transaction_characteristic.description: If ON, track transaction characteristics in session.

session_track_transaction_state.description: If ON, track transaction state in session.

session_track_transactions.description: If ON, track transaction info in session.

session_track_views.description: If ON, track view changes in session.

shared_memory.description: If ON, enable shared memory connections (Windows only).

show_old_temporals.description: If ON, show pre-5.6 TIMESTAMP format.

skip_name_resolve.description: If ON, skip DNS hostname resolution.

skip_slave_start.description: If ON, don't start slave threads automatically.

slave_allow_batching.description: If ON, allow batching of slave events.

slave_compressed_protocol.description: If ON, use compression for replication.

slave_max_allowed_packet.description: Max packet size for slave applier.

slave_net_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for more data from master before aborting.

slave_parallel_threads.description: Number of slave parallel worker threads.

slave_pending_jobs_size_max.description: Max memory for pending slave jobs.

slave_skip_errors.description: Comma-separated list of errors to skip.

slave_sql_verify_checksum.description: If ON, verify checksums on slave.

slave_transaction_retries.description: Max retries on slave transaction failures.

slow_launch_time.description: Seconds for slow thread creation warning.

slow_query_log.description: If ON, slow query log is enabled.

slow_query_log_file.description: Name of the slow query log file.

sort_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for each session's sort operations.

sql_auto_is_null.description: If ON, last inserted AUTO_INCREMENT value is returned by SELECT * FROM t WHERE auto_col IS NULL.

sql_buffer_result.description: If ON, force result sets to be stored in temporary tables.

sql_log_bin.description: If OFF, disable binary logging for current session.

sql_log_off.description: If ON, disable general query logging for current session.

sql_notes.description: If ON, generate notes for warnings.

sql_quote_show_create.description: If ON, quote table/database names in SHOW CREATE.

sql_safe_updates.description: If ON, prevent UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE or LIMIT.

sql_select_limit.description: Max rows returned by SELECT (0 = no limit).

sql_warnings.description: If ON, generate warnings for statements.

ssl_cert.description: Server public key certificate for SSL.

ssl_crlpath.description: Certificate revocation list directory for SSL.

super_large_pages.description: If ON, use large pages for super global memory.

super_read_only.description: If ON, enforce read-only mode including super users.

sync_binlog.description: Number of events to group before syncing binlog to disk.

sync_frm.description: If ON, sync .frm files to disk.

sync_master_info.description: Number of events before syncing master info.

sync_relay_log.description: Number of events before syncing relay log.

sync_relay_log_info.description: Number of events before syncing relay log info.

temptable_size_limit.description: Max size for temporary table data.

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep in cache.

thread_pool_traffic_control.description: If ON, enable traffic control in thread pool.

time_zone.description: Time zone for current session or global.

timed_mutexes.description: If ON, time mutexes in Performance Schema.

tmp_disk_table_size.description: Max size of on-disk temporary tables.

tmp_table_size.description: Max size of in-memory temporary tables.

transaction_alloc_block_size.description: Allocation block size for transaction memory.

transaction_prealloc_size.description: Initial size of transaction memory buffer.

transaction_write_set_extraction.description: Write set extraction algorithm for MGR.

unique_checks.description: If OFF, skip unique key checks.

updatable_views_with_limit.description: If YES, allow UPDATE/DELETE on views with LIMIT.

wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for activity before closing connection.

warning_count.description: Number of warnings from last statement.

webauth_challenge_cache.description: Max number of cached WebAuthn challenges.

AllowAlternateShell.description: Allows users to use alternate shells

AlwaysGroupCheck.description: Requires group membership even if group doesn't exist

DefaultWindowManager.description: Full or relative path of default session startup script

DisconnectedTimeLimit.description: Time limit in seconds to kill disconnected sessions (min 60, xorgxrdp only)

EnableFuseMount.description: Enables FUSE-based drive redirection and file copy-paste

EnableProcessId.description: Enables logging process ID in log messages

FileUmask.description: Umask applied to files in FuseMountName directory

IdleTimeLimit.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting session (0 = no timeout, xorgxrdp only)

MaxSessions.description: Maximum number of simultaneous sessions (0 = unlimited)

ReconnectScript.description: Full or relative path of reconnect script

TerminalServerAdmins.description: Group name for session management rights (currently ignored)

TerminalServerUsers.description: Group name whose members are allowed to login

UserWindowManager.description: Path of user startup script relative to user's home directory

X11DisplayOffset.description: First X display number for xrdp-sesman

AddKeysToAgent.description: Specifies whether keys should be automatically added to a running ssh-agent.

AddressFamily.description: Specifies which address family to use when connecting.

BatchMode.description: If set to yes, disables user interaction such as password prompts and host key confirmation.

BindAddress.description: Use the specified address on the local machine as the source address of the connection.

BindInterface.description: Use the address of the specified interface on the local machine as the source address of the connection.

CASignatureAlgorithms.description: Specifies which algorithms are allowed for signing of certificates by CAs.

CanonicalDomains.description: When CanonicalizeHostname is enabled, specifies the list of domain suffixes to search.

CanonicalizeFallbackLocal.description: Specifies whether to fail with an error when hostname canonicalization fails.

CanonicalizeHostname.description: Controls whether explicit hostname canonicalization is performed.

CanonicalizeMaxDots.description: Specifies the maximum number of dot characters in a hostname before canonicalization is disabled.

CanonicalizePermittedCNAMEs.description: Specifies rules to determine whether CNAMEs should be followed during hostname canonicalization.

CertificateFile.description: Specifies a file from which the user's certificate is read.

ChannelTimeout.description: Specifies timeouts for inactive channels in type=interval format.

CheckHostIP.description: If set to yes, ssh will check the host IP address in known_hosts file.

Ciphers.description: Specifies the ciphers allowed and their order of preference.

ClearAllForwardings.description: Clears all local, remote, and dynamic port forwardings.

ConnectTimeout.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds used when connecting to the SSH server.

ConnectionAttempts.description: Specifies the number of connection tries (one per second) before exiting.

ControlMaster.description: Enables sharing of multiple sessions over a single network connection.

ControlPath.description: Specify the path to the control socket used for connection sharing.

ControlPersist.description: When used with ControlMaster, specifies how long the master connection should remain open in background.

DynamicForward.description: Specifies that a TCP port on the local machine be forwarded over the secure channel.

EnableEscapeCommandline.description: Enables the command line option in the EscapeChar menu for interactive sessions.

EnableSSHKeysign.description: Enables the use of ssh-keysign(8) during HostbasedAuthentication.

ExitOnForwardFailure.description: Specifies whether ssh should terminate if port forwardings cannot be set up.

FingerprintHash.description: Specifies the hash algorithm used when displaying key fingerprints.

ForkAfterAuthentication.description: Requests ssh to go to background just before command execution.

ForwardAgent.description: Specifies whether the connection to the authentication agent will be forwarded.

ForwardX11.description: Specifies whether X11 connections will be automatically redirected.

ForwardX11Timeout.description: Specify a timeout for untrusted X11 forwarding.

ForwardX11Trusted.description: If set to yes, remote X11 clients will have full access to the original X11 display.

GSSAPIClientIdentity.description: Specifies the GSSAPI client identity to use.

GSSAPIKexAlgorithms.description: The list of key exchange algorithms offered for GSSAPI key exchange.

GSSAPIServerIdentity.description: Specifies the GSSAPI server identity to expect.

GSSAPITrustDns.description: Set to yes to indicate that the DNS is trusted to securely canonicalize the host name.

GatewayPorts.description: Specifies whether remote hosts are allowed to connect to local forwarded ports.

GlobalKnownHostsFile.description: Specifies one or more files to use for the global host key database.

HashKnownHosts.description: Indicates that ssh should hash host names and addresses in known_hosts.

HostKeyAlgorithms.description: Specifies the host key signature algorithms that the client wants to use in order of preference.

HostKeyAlias.description: Specifies an alias for the real host name when looking up or saving host keys.

HostbasedAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be used for hostbased authentication.

HostbasedAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to try rhosts based authentication with public key authentication.

Hostname.description: Specifies the real host name to log into.

IPQoS.description: Specifies the IPv4 type-of-service or DSCP class for connections.

IdentitiesOnly.description: Specifies that ssh should only use the configured authentication identity and certificate files.

IdentityAgent.description: Specifies the Unix-domain socket used to communicate with the authentication agent.

IdentityFile.description: Specifies a file from which the user's authentication identity is read.

IgnoreUnknown.description: Specifies a pattern-list of unknown options to be ignored during config parsing.

KbdInteractiveAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to use keyboard-interactive authentication.

KbdInteractiveDevices.description: Specifies the list of methods to use in keyboard-interactive authentication.

KexAlgorithms.description: Specifies the available KEX (Key Exchange) algorithms.

KnownHostsCommand.description: Specifies a command to use to obtain a list of host keys.

LocalCommand.description: Specifies a command to execute on the local machine after connecting to the server.

LocalForward.description: Specifies that a TCP port on the local machine be forwarded to the remote host.

LogLevel.description: Gives the verbosity level used when logging messages from ssh.

LogVerbose.description: Specify one or more overrides to LogLevel for debugging.

MACs.description: Specifies the MAC algorithms in order of preference.

NoHostAuthenticationForLocalhost.description: Disable host authentication for localhost (loopback addresses).

NumberOfPasswordPrompts.description: Specifies the number of password prompts before giving up.

PasswordAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to use password authentication.
