Port.description: Specifies the port number to connect on the remote host.

PreferredAuthentications.description: Specifies the order in which the client should try authentication methods.

ProxyCommand.description: Specifies the command to use to connect to the server.

ProxyJump.description: Specifies one or more jump proxies for the connection.

ProxyUseFdpass.description: Specifies that ProxyCommand will pass a connected file descriptor back to ssh.

PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be used for public key authentication.

PubkeyAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to try public key authentication.

RekeyLimit.description: Specifies maximum amount of data before session key renegotiation, optionally followed by a time limit.

RemoteCommand.description: Specifies a command to execute on the remote machine after connecting.

RemoteForward.description: Specifies that a TCP port on the remote machine be forwarded over the secure channel.

content.description: Allowed content types per storage backend (common + backend-specific).

content-dirs.description: Custom directory layout overrides in the format vtype=path.

disable.description: Disable the storage completely.

encryption-key.description: AES-256-GCM encryption key for PBS backups (pbs).

format.description: Supported image formats (backend-specific combinations).

fuse.description: Access CephFS through FUSE instead of kernel client (cephfs).

is_mountpoint.description: Actual mount point when adding a BTRFS subdirectory as storage (btrfs).

iscsiprovider.description: iSCSI target implementation on remote host (zfs).

krbd.description: Enforce access to RBD through krbd kernel module (rbd).

lio_tpg.description: Target portal group for Linux LIO (zfs).

master-pubkey.description: RSA public key for backup encryption key recovery (pbs).

monhost.description: List of Ceph monitor IPs (rbd, cephfs).

nodes.description: List of cluster node names where this storage is usable/accessible.

nowritecache.description: Disable write caching on the target (zfs).

options.description: Mount options (for nfs, cifs).

password.description: Password for CIFS (cifs) or PBS (pbs).

path.description: Directory or mount point path (for dir, nfs, cifs, cephfs).

pool.description: ZFS pool or filesystem (zfspool, zfs), or Ceph pool (rbd).

port.description: Proxmox Backup Server port (default 8007) (pbs).

preallocation.description: Preallocation mode for raw and qcow2 images on file-based storages.

server.description: Server IP or DNS name (for nfs, cifs, pbs, rbd, cephfs, iscsi, iscsidirect, zfs).

shared.description: Indicate that this is a single storage with the same contents on all nodes.

snapshot-as-volume-chain.description: Enable snapshot support using volume chains (lvm, lvmthin).

subdir.description: Subdirectory of the CIFS share or CephFS path to mount (cifs, cephfs).

username.description: Username for CIFS (cifs), PBS (pbs), RBD (rbd), CephFS (cephfs).

alert_priority.description: Syslog priority for alert messages from client

connect_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for relay connection to complete; 0 disables timeout

iolog_dir.description: Top-level directory for constructing I/O log paths

iolog_file.description: Relative path within iolog_dir where I/O logs are stored

iolog_flush.description: Flush I/O log data to disk after each write

iolog_group.description: Group to set on new I/O log files/directories

iolog_mode.description: File mode for I/O log files (octal)

iolog_user.description: User to set on new I/O log files/directories

listen_address.description: Host name or IP address, optional port, and optional TLS flag for server to listen on

log_exit.description: Log event when command exits or is terminated

log_passwords.description: Include passwords in terminal I/O logs if present

log_type.description: Where to log security policy events

logfile_path.description: Path to file-based event log (must start with '/')

logfile_time_format.description: strftime format for timestamps in file-based logs

maxlen.description: Max syslog message length in bytes; longer messages are split

maxseq.description: Maximum decimal value for %{seq} escape (base-36: ZZZZZZ)

passprompt_regex.description: POSIX extended regex to match password prompts (multiple allowed)

pid_file.description: Path to the file containing the process ID of the running sudo_logsrvd

relay_dir.description: Directory for temporarily storing logs before relaying

relay_host.description: Relay host name or IP, optional port, optional TLS flag (no wildcards allowed)

relay_tcp_keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on relay connections

relay_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for relay to respond after connection succeeds; 0 disables timeout

relay_tls_cacert.description: Relay TLS CA certificate path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_cert.description: Relay TLS certificate path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_checkpeer.description: Validate relay host certificate; defaults to server value

relay_tls_ciphers_v12.description: TLS 1.2 ciphers for relay; defaults to server value

relay_tls_ciphers_v13.description: TLS 1.3 ciphers for relay; defaults to server value

relay_tls_dhparams.description: Relay TLS DH params path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_key.description: Relay TLS private key path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_verify.description: Verify server certificate used for relaying; defaults to server value

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait after a relay connection error before retrying

server_facility.description: Syslog facility for server warning messages

server_log.description: Where to log server warning and error messages

store_first.description: Store logs locally before relaying (store-and-forward mode)

tcp_keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on client connections

timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for client to respond; 0 disables timeout

tls_cacert.description: Path to certificate authority bundle for authenticating clients

tls_cert.description: Path to server's TLS certificate file

tls_checkpeer.description: Validate client certificates; clients without valid cert cannot connect if true

tls_dhparams.description: Path to custom Diffie-Hellman parameters file

tls_key.description: Path to server's private key file

tls_verify.description: Validate server's own certificate at startup

services.description: List of PAM service names the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators, and single * wildcard)

times.description: Time restrictions as logic list of day/time-range entries (e.g., Mo0900-1700, Wk1800-0800); supports ! prefix and standard day codes (Mo-Su, Wk, Wd, Al)

ttys.description: List of terminal (tty) names the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators, and single * wildcard)

users.description: List of users or netgroups the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators and single * wildcard; netgroups disallow wildcards and operators)

conf_force_conffnew.default: unset (script asks in case of doubt)
conf_force_conffnew.description: Force overriding the installed config file

conf_force_conffold.default: unset (script asks in case of doubt)
conf_force_conffold.description: Force retaining the installed config file

conf_old_mdsum_file.description: Explicit file to read historical md5sums from

conf_source_dir.description: Directory where historical md5sums for files are looked for

AllowAnyRoot.description: Controls whether TLS connections using non-CA-signed certificates are allowed.

AllowExpiredCerts.description: Controls whether TLS connections using expired certificates are allowed.

Encryption.description: Sets the encryption level for client-server connections.

GSSServiceName.description: Sets the Kerberos service name used for authentication (e.g., host, http, ipp).

SSLOptions.description: Sets advanced SSL/TLS options (AllowDH, AllowRC4, AllowSSL3, DenyCBC, DenyTLS1.0, Min/MaxTLSx.y).

ServerName.description: Sets the server address (hostname/IP[:port] or socket path) for CUPS connections.

TrustOnFirstUse.description: Controls whether new TLS certificates are trusted by default.

User.description: Sets the default username for client requests.

UserAgentTokens.description: Controls the detail level of User-Agent HTTP header information.

ValidateCerts.description: Controls whether TLS certificates must match the remote host name.

.include.description: Include another configuration file or directory.

.pragma.description: Set parsing behavior flags (e.g., abspath, dollarid, includedir).

MinProtocol.description: Minimum supported protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.2, DTLSv1.2).

abspath.description: If true, .include pathnames must be absolute.

activate.description: Whether to activate the provider; value is ignored.

alg_section.description: Name of the section containing EVP algorithm properties.

cipher.description: Cipher used by CTR-DRBG (ignored by other DRBGs).

config_diagnostics.description: Enable or disable error suppression; nonzero value enables diagnostics.

default_properties.description: Property query string for EVP default properties.

digest.description: Digest used by HASH-DRBG or HMAC-DRBG (ignored by others).

dollarid.description: If true, treat $ as literal (disable variable expansion).

dynamic_path.description: Path to load an ENGINE module.

engines.description: List of engine names mapping to their configuration sections.

fips_mode.description: Deprecated; if yes, sets default_properties = fips=yes.

includedir.description: Base directory prepended to relative .include pathnames if OPENSSL_CONF_INCLUDE is unset.

init.description: Whether to initialize the ENGINE immediately (1 = yes, 0 = no).

module.description: Path to the provider shared library.

oid_section.description: Name of the section containing OID definitions.

openssl_conf.description: Name of the section containing OpenSSL initialization configuration.

properties.description: Property query for fetching the RNG and underlying algorithms.

providers.description: List of provider names mapping to their configuration sections.

seed_properties.description: Property query for fetching the randomness source.

ssl_conf.description: Name of the section containing SSL/TLS configuration sections.

backup_initramfs.description: If set to yes, keeps a .bak backup of the previous initramfs.

update_initramfs.description: Controls whether initramfs updates are performed: yes (latest only), no (disabled), or all (all known initramfs).

PRUNEFS.description: Whitespace-separated list of file system types to skip during scanning.

PRUNENAMES.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory names to skip during scanning.

PRUNEPATHS.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory paths to skip during scanning.

PRUNE_BIND_MOUNTS.description: Whether to skip bind mounts (1/yes to skip).

enabled.description: When set to False, xdg-user-dirs-update will not change the XDG user dirs configuration.

filename_encoding.description: Sets the filename encoding to use (e.g., UTF-8 or locale).

DESKTOP.description: Default path for the Desktop directory, relative to the home directory.

DOCUMENTS.description: Default path for the Documents directory, relative to the home directory.

DOWNLOAD.description: Default path for the Downloads directory, relative to the home directory.

MUSIC.description: Default path for the Music directory, relative to the home directory.

PICTURES.description: Default path for the Pictures directory, relative to the home directory.

PUBLICSHARE.description: Default path for the Public share directory, relative to the home directory.

TEMPLATES.description: Default path for the Templates directory, relative to the home directory.

VIDEOS.description: Default path for the Videos directory, relative to the home directory.

comment.description: Comment or note about this user.

enabled.description: Whether this user is enabled or disabled.

dumpdir.description: Store resulting files to specified directory.

enabled.description: Enable backup fleecing.

ionice.description: Set IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler.

keep-all.description: Keep all backups. Conflicts with other options when true.

keep-daily.description: Keep backups for the last N different days.

keep-hourly.description: Keep backups for the last N different hours.

keep-monthly.description: Keep backups for the last N different months.

keep-weekly.description: Keep backups for the last N different weeks.

keep-yearly.description: Keep backups for the last N different years.

lockwait.description: Maximal time to wait for the global lock (minutes).

mailnotification.description: Deprecated: use notification targets/matchers instead. Specify when to send a notification mail.

mailto.description: Deprecated: Use notification targets/matchers instead. Comma-separated list of email addresses or users that should receive email notifications.

max-workers.description: Allow up to this many IO workers at the same time for VMs.

mode.description: Backup mode.

notes-template.description: Template string for generating notes for the backup(s).

notification-mode.description: Determine which notification system to use.

pbs-change-detection-mode.description: PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups.

pbs-entries-max.description: Limits number of entries allowed in memory for container backups to PBS.

pigz.description: Use pigz instead of gzip when N>0.

pool.description: Backup all known guest systems included in the specified pool.

protected.description: If true, mark backup(s) as protected.

prune-backups.description: Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.

remove.description: Prune older backups according to prune-backups.

stopwait.description: Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped (minutes).

storage.description: Store resulting file to this storage.

tmpdir.description: Store temporary files to specified directory.

AccelerationThreshold.description: sets velocity threshold for acceleration to take effect

AdaptiveDeceleration.description: allows deceleration at low pointer speeds

AllowByteSwappedClients.description: allows clients with different byte-order than the server

AllowMouseOpenFail.description: tells mousedrv/vmmouse not to report failure if mouse can't be opened

AllowNonLocalXvidtune.description: allows xvidtune to connect from another host

AutoAddDevices.description: enables automatic input device addition from HAL/udev

AutoAddGPU.description: enables automatic GPU device addition from udev

AutoBindGPU.description: enables automatic secondary GPU setup as output-sources

AutoEnableDevices.description: enables automatic device enabling after adding

AutoServerLayout.description: always adds the device to the ServerLayout section

BlankTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for blank phase of screensaver (minutes)

BusID.description: specifies the bus location of the graphics card

Chipset.description: specifies the chipset used on the graphics board

Clocks.description: specifies pixel clocks supported by the graphics board

ConstantDeceleration.description: multiplies pointer speed by a constant factor

DisableVidModeExtension.description: disables VidMode extension parts used by xvidtune

DisplaySize.description: specifies physical width/height of monitor in mm

DontVTSwitch.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Fn sequence for virtual terminal switching

DontZap.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Backspace to terminate X server

Floating.description: sets up device floating (no event reporting via master device)

FontPath.description: sets the search path for fonts

GlxVisuals.description: controls how many GLX visuals are set up

HTimings.description: horizontal timings for a video mode

IgnoreABI.description: allows modules built for a different X server version to load

IndirectGLX.description: enables or disables indirect GLX contexts

Load.description: loads a specified Xorg server module

MatchDriver.description: matches kernel driver name for outputs

MatchProduct.description: matches substring in device's product name

MatchSeat.description: matches seat ID from -seat server option

MatchVendor.description: matches substring in device's vendor name

MaxClients.description: sets maximum number of clients allowed to connect

MemBase.description: specifies linear frame buffer base address

ModeLine.description: compact definition for a video mode

ModulePath.description: sets the search path for loadable Xorg server modules

NoMatchProduct.description: negative match for product name substring

NoMatchTag.description: negative match for config backend tags

NoMatchVendor.description: negative match for vendor name substring

NoOutputInitialSize.description: overrides screen size when no outputs are connected

OffTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS off phase (minutes)

Position.description: specifies position of monitor (x y coordinates)

PreferCloneMode.description: prefers clone mode for monitors over horizontal extend

PreferredMode.description: specifies preferred initial video mode for monitor

Screen.description: specifies which display head this device applies to

StandbyTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS standby phase (minutes)

SuspendTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS suspend phase (minutes)

SyncOnGreen.description: drives sync signal on green color pin

TransformationMatrix.description: 3x3 transformation matrix for absolute input devices

UseDefaultFontPath.description: includes default font path even if other paths are specified

UseModes.description: includes video modes from named Modes section

VScan.description: number of times each scanline is painted

VTimings.description: vertical timings for a video mode

VideoRam.description: specifies video RAM size in kBytes

XkbDir.description: sets the base directory for keyboard layout files

ZoomModes.description: specifies modes for zoom switching via keypad
